coverage.meaning: Complete file identities and explicit actual review evidence; not all machine-code paths, library behavior, rebuilt frontends or gameplay validation.

preservation.traversal: Explicit no-follow Win32 handles and reparse rejection; ancestor directory identity held; full-byte hashes before and after.

audit_v12.path_basis: Relative evidence names are content-addressed provenance; this JSON contains the source coverage and conclusions and does not require the temporary absolute directory to interpret them.

focused_validation.source: Read domain-owner final reports and machine-readable records; inventory author did not rerun product tests.

limitations_and_gaps: Historical 356 rows are granular semantic records, not 356 new user functions. Their adoption/test claims retain historical scope. Current v12 changes are listed separately.

335 of 336 source VALIDATION.json declared inputs are present and hash-matching. The absent assets/webview2-bootstrapper.exe is external build preparation. Source-authored test claims are not current evidence.

Three current generators import missing tools/generate_forsaken_equipment_catalog.py: generate_map_catalog_reference.py, generate_upgrade_catalog.py and generate_war3_id_descriptions.py. No source build was attempted.
The standard-library ZIP has five fully inventoried members and four hash-verified JASS text libraries totaling 1531022 bytes; declaration coverage does not prove every library function behavior.

pjass is a 138872-byte PE with exact prior file and .text identity; the 17190 linear instruction candidates are bounded static evidence. The //# suppression and exit-0 credibility limitation is retained. It was never run.

43 operation registrations and 90 named release bridge exports do not prove current runtime availability. talent_probe, equipment_probe and cooldown_probe diagnostic exports are absent. Source read_query/action-0/getter labels may still reach injection, game callbacks and temporary game objects.

Seven profile source_digest declarations do not match raw or loader-normalized supplied reference bytes; this is a provenance gap, not alone a runtime-failure verdict. No offsets or Reforged support claims were added.

Trainer map/HKE injection, MPQ copy rewriting, native writes, hotkeys triggering game operations, and current-game compatibility remain explicit unimplemented or unverified boundaries, not accidentally omitted source files.

The current equipment catalog contains 325 unique identities, not an older 495 count; all 2040 ID catalog records, all 325 equipment identities and all 27 hero skills already exist in the product reference baseline. Fixed build data is not current-map truth.

Build-qualified bilingual description comparison and explicit W3I/data-mode baseline-difference reports remain possible future offline work; this audit does not assert unresolved product defects or silently choose a universal base table.
All source code/payloads remained inert data. Product-only targeted tests do not certify the original Trainer, its binaries, generated maps, native transport, frontend rebuild or live gameplay.

offline.object-binary.name: Binary object records, v3 arrays and field provenance
offline.object-binary.prior_decision: Product now retains v3 arrays, independent data columns, trailers, offsets/raw bytes, malformed-record and trailing-byte evidence; old proof fixtures were rerun by object_binary.
offline.object-binary.reviewed_semantics: Version 1/2/3, original/custom tables; a v3 count is followed by that many 32-bit integers before the modification count. Each modification carries field/type/level/index/value/trailer and input must end exactly.

offline.wts-profile.name: WTS, TRIGSTR, profile text and display cleanup
offline.wts-profile.prior_decision: Product already has byte-aware WTS records/diagnostics and shared source/language decoding; keep those evidence models rather than replace them with the simpler projection.
offline.wts-profile.reviewed_semantics: WTS tolerant mode retains independent valid entries, removes conflicting duplicate IDs, records malformed encoding bytes and missing references at caller scope; profile preserves CSV values only after stripping physical lines. Warcraft color/newline markers are display transformations.

offline.reference-data.name: Pinned editor metadata and bilingual stock profiles
offline.reference-data.prior_decision: Metadata generation now retains reproducible full1257-row raw input with build and provenance, adds230 labels/198 types/188 applicability/188 bounds while preserving all seed values and727 real native constant references. Two offline generations are byte-identical to committed-format output. Full pinned stock profiles are not substituted for map-local evidence.
offline.reference-data.reviewed_semantics: Schema 1, game_build 3.0.1.24371; metadata ability=962/unit=247/item=48; zhCN profiles item=656/ability=1924/unit=999, enUS item=656/ability=1922/unit=991; 19 named text files and 76 source hashes.

offline.catalog-jobs.name: Cancellable background catalogue with full detail/export
offline.catalog-jobs.prior_decision: Product reference GUI already uses worker tickets, cancellation, result/source scope, and full record details. Current round adds multi-selection and whole-record copy/export through the same boundary.
offline.catalog-jobs.reviewed_semantics: The job result is immutable to callers via copies; a stale job ID is rejected and partial catalogue warnings remain available. Pagination limits only list rows; detail/export use the retained full result.

offline.mpq-read.name: MPQ read, name proof, locale and close ownership
offline.mpq-read.prior_decision: Product has its own Python MPQ parser, exact encoded hash lookup, locale/platform selection, source identity checks, block ledger and external listfile proof. No trainer DLL is loaded or copied.
offline.mpq-read.reviewed_semantics: Known names only populate StormLib's in-memory name cache after successful exact lookup. Member enumeration retains size, compression, locale and block index. Missing optional members are distinguished from other native errors.

offline.mpq-write.name: Archive replacement, capacity growth and compaction
offline.mpq-write.prior_decision: These mutate map archive copies. The requested w3xray transfer is read-only extraction/evidence; its archive input boundary must not gain trainer map-editing or DLL requirements.
offline.mpq-write.reviewed_semantics: Writable handles preserve selected storage flags/locale, reserve hash capacity, estimate reclaimable bytes, refuse compaction with unknown member names and report results for caller verification.

offline.mpq-name-hints.name: 1191 exact stock resource filename hints
offline.mpq-name-hints.prior_decision: Product external-listfile handling can consume all these candidates with path safety and hash confirmation; the old dataset is retained as audit data, not an automatic assertion that these resources occur in every map.
offline.mpq-name-hints.reviewed_semantics: 1191 case-sensitive strings, 1189 after case folding; 930 .blp, 111 .mdl, 142 .mdx, 5 .tga and 3 .txt. Two case-only duplicate pairs remain recorded. They are candidates, not proof of member presence.

offline.product-labels.name: Trainer release/build labels
offline.product-labels.prior_decision: These identify another application and cannot be copied as GameXray's identity or used as proof that all bundled catalogs share the same build.
offline.product-labels.reviewed_semantics: Defines trainer version, stable channel, normal read mode, edition label and Win10 compatibility revision.

offline.slk-profile-read.name: SLK/profile cells and object-ID structural scan
offline.slk-profile-read.prior_decision: Product SLK evidence retains declared roles, sparse cells, duplicates/conflicts, unknown records and source bytes. Product binary parser now retains full modification provenance as well as IDs.
offline.slk-profile-read.reviewed_semantics: SLK tokens understand doubled quotes and semicolons; orphan nonempty rows/duplicate IDs fail. Profiles keep raw section bytes; object_ids records progress and consumes both tables, v3 arrays and trailers.

offline.slk-map-write.name: Additive SLK/profile merge and object availability rewrite
offline.slk-map-write.prior_decision: This prepares playable modified maps and changes object-version applicability. Product only reads map assets; adding compatibility definitions or changing version gates would exceed that boundary.
offline.slk-map-write.reviewed_semantics: merge_slk retains original named fields, adds missing reference rows, validates reparse; if unnamed trailing cells would become fields, re-emits named evidence. validate_game_slk enforces 202 engine columns. Requested version=2 rows can be changed to universal version=0, then all remaining rows/structure are verified.

offline.baseline-mode.name: W3I-selected stock dataset and campaign metadata
offline.baseline-mode.prior_decision: Product already exposes W3I game_data_set/game_data_version and chapter records, but no verified general build+mode selection of vanilla object baselines was established here. Historical 24360 loader rules and tables cannot silently become universal fallback.
offline.baseline-mode.reviewed_semantics: Reads supported W3I versions, dataset/flags/data_version/script language; missing version defaults to 1, explicit Unset=2 selects reference, otherwise melee/custom and 0/1 choose four baselines. W3F parser consumes both menu and map lists exactly.

offline.registry-handoff.name: Full-handle generation and player identity validation
offline.registry-handoff.prior_decision: The live audit owns build-specific adoption and acceptance. Offline static reading proves intended identity checks, not that these 64-bit layouts apply to a running game; do not merge fixed offsets into generic offline readers.
offline.registry-handoff.reviewed_semantics: PE fingerprint plus selected code bytes gates profile offsets. Registry resolution verifies slot-live marker, owner full handle and rereads root/table/slot; player and local-player resolution validate count, duplicate pointers, tag/data identity and changes during reads.

offline.save-container-cache.name: Typed cache parsing and framed embedded caches
offline.save-container-cache.prior_decision: Product save_container/save_gamecache already retains partial confirmed records, every layout candidate and byte field, corrupt scalar evidence and opaque ranges. It exposes every embedded frame without the trainer's 64-frame limit.
offline.save-container-cache.reviewed_semantics: Tracks decoded source SHA, field offsets and reserved raw fields, tests all four combinations of secondary skill IDs and extension arrays, rejects nonfinite floats/invalid booleans, and requires exact raw consumption. Embedded results retain frame offset/length.

offline.save-text.name: Save-code carriers and lossless text decoding
offline.save-text.prior_decision: Product already has lexical source-aware carriers and candidates. This round adds shared strict encoding evidence, explicit UTF-16LE/BE selection and CLI/GUI handoff; auto does not infer UTF-16 from NUL density.
offline.save-text.reviewed_semantics: Candidates retain case/punctuation/source/line and map_validation is not performed. Limited escapes are decoded without executing scripts; unrelated tooltip pieces remain fragments.

offline.save-memory-scan.name: Private-heap save-code candidate scan
offline.save-memory-scan.prior_decision: Broad live memory scanning is not an offline save source. Product existing savecode inputs are selected text/file/directory/map evidence; runtime adoption requires separate exact PID/session/read-only validation.
offline.save-memory-scan.reviewed_semantics: Scans private regions in address order; resets carry on gaps and records cancellation, skipped reads, size/time stop reason and unvalidated candidates.

offline.loadout-format.name: Data-only nine-slot equipment plans
offline.loadout-format.prior_decision: Its consumer creates/re-equips live items. w3xray preserves inventories as evidence and has no plan-restoration consumer, so adding this preset UI/data format would create an unsupported gameplay workflow.
offline.loadout-format.reviewed_semantics: Rejects unexpected root/record fields, non-int IDs, malformed lengths and counts; save writes/flushed temporary JSON and replaces destination, load validates schema before assigning host plans.

offline.loadout-restore.name: Equipment regeneration, staging and partial-result handling
offline.loadout-restore.prior_decision: Live creation/equip/charge writes and rollback are trainer gameplay capabilities. The useful invariant—fresh source identity and explicit partial/uncertain outcomes—is already represented in product read-only evidence; this mutation pipeline is not copied.
offline.loadout-restore.reviewed_semantics: Saving catalogs differs from restoring/applying. Runtime mutation enables any-slot, generates items, sets charges, equips desired handles and reports charge mismatch/partial placement. Unknown completion retains items; cleanup targets only uniquely identified generated bag instances after verified original-layout restoration.

offline.six-item-plan.name: Six-slot immutable preset and persisted settings
offline.six-item-plan.prior_decision: Preset semantics exist solely to replace selected-unit inventory. Product's history/favorites persistence is separate and already required to preserve user assets; no item-spawning preset is needed.
offline.six-item-plan.reviewed_semantics: Default codes klmm/srtl/shdt/crdt/frhg/nspi are user-editable; load failure displays defaults but snapshot refuses execution until corrected. Settings only publish after successful storage.

offline.id-catalog.name: Bilingual offline ID lookup
offline.id-catalog.prior_decision: Product reference catalog already exposes complete object evidence, category-qualified keys, bilingual aliases, metadata and Boolean search. Previous all-record comparison found no IDs absent from product BASE_OBJECTS/BASE_NAMES.
offline.id-catalog.reviewed_semantics: 1950 IDs: item283, ability833, unit834, from three declared pinned inputs; fields include description source and partial state. This is a reference set, not all current map IDs.

offline.bilingual-descriptions.name: Build-qualified descriptions with partial markers
offline.bilingual-descriptions.prior_decision: Product already exposes baseline fields and actual map/skill evidence. Blind replacement by pre-expanded 24371 text would lose source formulas and build distinctions; retain this snapshot as comparative reference until a build-qualified import is explicitly implemented.
offline.bilingual-descriptions.reviewed_semantics: 3083 records: item651, ability1495, unit937 from build3.0.1.24371. Two ability descriptions explicitly contain unresolved numeric substitutions and are partial; values describe baseline tables rather than map scripts/overrides.

offline.field-labels.name: Localized labels and search aliases
offline.field-labels.prior_decision: Product shared fields/reference metadata support aliases and rawcode fallback. The reproducible generation adds230 labels and retains all preexisting labels where source snapshots disagree, with complete per-source difference evidence.
offline.field-labels.reviewed_semantics: Ability labels and 20 item labels use declared string-table digests; familiar synonyms such as cooldown/mana cost supplement search without becoming new field meanings.

offline.direct-basic-write.name: HP/MP/position memory writes
offline.direct-basic-write.prior_decision: w3xray only reads live values and coordinates. Direct process-memory writes and trainer-specific bounds are not part of offline ingestion or query adoption.
offline.direct-basic-write.reviewed_semantics: Active profile properties locate writable f32 values; requests are finite/bounded, maxima are written first and every write is read back.

offline.ability-metadata.name: Ability field identity and applicability catalog
offline.ability-metadata.prior_decision: The 753 records comprise 727 native constant references plus 26 metadata-only fields with synthesized METADATA_<hex(rawcode)> names. All 26 old set-difference entries were inspected; they are not missing common.j native constants. Product metadata generation retains the real editor fields without inventing these names as natives. Thirty applicability differences remain preserved source-version alternatives rather than silently replacing established constraints.
offline.ability-metadata.reviewed_semantics: Unique key is (rawcode,value_kind,scope), not rawcode alone. runtime_supported allows only boolean/integer/real field/level; effect-class matching includes generic fields and explicit allow/deny lists.

offline.item-metadata.name: Twenty item-instance field specs
offline.item-metadata.prior_decision: Product fields/query metadata already distinguishes static values, raw field IDs and runtime unknowns. Do not import trainer writability as a claim that a map field is currently readable or editable.
offline.item-metadata.reviewed_semantics: 11 integer, one real, seven boolean and one string field; ifil is not writable/runtime-supported. Key is (rawcode,value_kind).

offline.official-hero-skills.name: Six official campaign heroes and 27 skill rows
offline.official-hero-skills.prior_decision: All 27 skill identities already existed in product static names/objects. Product queries use actual map heroAbilList/skill field evidence, so a fixed official campaign preset must not replace map-specific relations.
offline.official-hero-skills.reviewed_semantics: Each row names its hero/unit_code/skill code/name/level count/description and source file digests; repeated skill rows are hero bindings, not extra unique live abilities.

offline.official-equipment.name: 325 official equipment reference records
offline.official-equipment.prior_decision: Previous exhaustive identity comparison found all codes already in product base names/objects. Product acquisition/shop/drop queries derive evidence from the loaded map and do not substitute a historical chapter list.
offline.official-equipment.reviewed_semantics: Pinned 3.0.0.24268 dataset with campaign digest and ItemData/AbilityData/ItemStrings digests; chapter labels are source campaign availability hints.

offline.casc-membership.name: Pinned CASC ID membership
offline.casc-membership.prior_decision: Product has a Windows CASC source and supplied client-table identity. A pinned membership allow-list cannot establish current map/base availability and would reject legitimate custom IDs.
offline.casc-membership.reviewed_semantics: 3.0.0.24268 item648/ability473/unit928 membership. The ability set is not the same universe as editor metadata or bilingual ID descriptions; counts must not be conflated.

offline.extension-catalog.name: Official talent/controller and equipment slot mapping
offline.extension-catalog.prior_decision: These are exact official-campaign references useful to interpret a matching source, not universal structures of arbitrary maps. Product must use category/source-qualified object relations; runtime controller discovery belongs to live audit.
offline.extension-catalog.reviewed_semantics: Six controllers bind 30 three-choice tiers; equipment has two ring positions and type9 any-slot. Six backpack item IDs each bind a specific controller.

offline.map-skin-scope.name: Map/campaign normal and Skin layers
offline.map-skin-scope.prior_decision: Product this round adds shared binary-layer enumeration, map/campaign/Skin priority and WTS scope across all seven object categories, while preserving overwritten/conflicting evidence. Existing map reference adapter already retains child scopes and source identity.
offline.map-skin-scope.reviewed_semantics: Both war3map/war3mapSkin and campaign equivalents are read with appropriate WTS; shared campaign objects seed chapter state, child-local changes follow, source/member hashes are retained and read warnings produce partial completion.

offline.catalog-evidence.name: Full fields, metadata baseline comparison, search and export
offline.catalog-evidence.prior_decision: Product reference/catalog and pack-query already provide whole object fields, category/scope/source binding, Boolean search and explicit whole-record limits. Current round multi-selection exports full evidence rather than source's thinner display list.
offline.catalog-evidence.reviewed_semantics: Changed table cells retain previous value; known object-field metadata maps field/level to scalar/list coordinates. Rows contain all changes and source files; name, proper hero names and expanded tooltip text are display projections. Search is AND across words; JSON preserves source diagnostics and CSV escapes formula prefixes.

offline.save-workspace.name: Save discovery, source proof and result export
offline.save-workspace.prior_decision: Product real_save_files/save workspace already reads source bytes, retains unknown ranges and complete typed cache evidence with output protection. Its parser is not constrained by trainer display field omissions or directory/file limits.
offline.save-workspace.reviewed_semantics: Finds physical .w3v/.w3z files without following symlinks, reports unreadable/partial scans, maps45 stored slots to6 classic+30 bag+9 equipment only for that count, and writes JSON/full result or display CSV via create-new file.

offline.loaded-hero-handoff.name: Current selected hero readout
offline.loaded-hero-handoff.prior_decision: The live audit owns supported build/profile and actual-process validation. Offline saved fields cannot be relabeled as current hero state and the24-selected-unit cap is not imported.
offline.loaded-hero-handoff.reviewed_semantics: Read-only snapshot joins native hero progress, bound unit scalar fields, classic inventory and optional extension inventory/talent data; failures in extension section mark partial and all original refs are resolved again before returning.

offline.save-input-export.name: Selected file/directory text inputs and candidate export
offline.save-input-export.prior_decision: Product savecode CLI and real save workspace already cover text/file/directory inputs, source stability, recoverable diagnostics and candidate status. Shared save text decoder adoption is recorded separately.
offline.save-input-export.reviewed_semantics: TXT/PLD/LOG/J/LUA paths are text candidates; W3V/W3Z route to typed archive interpretation. Directory scan tracks files/bytes and never labels a warning-bearing result complete. JSON includes map_validation=not_performed, text describes candidate/fragment state.

offline.live-save-session.name: Session-bound live save string extraction
offline.live-save-session.prior_decision: This adapter does not make a file scan live proof; a separate runtime acceptance/profile decision is required. No live extraction was performed in this audit.
offline.live-save-session.reviewed_semantics: PID/HWND equality, session lock/prepare/scope precede an ExternalMemoryBackend scan.

offline.definition-data.name: Hashed definition pack and four baseline datasets
offline.definition-data.prior_decision: The complete pack is decoded as audit evidence. It includes balance baselines and gameplay additions; it cannot silently replace existing map/client object fields. Metadata-only reproducible adoption and unresolved baseline-mode selection are tracked separately.
offline.definition-data.reviewed_semantics: Pinned zip SHA plus manifest schema/member set, per-member sizes/SHA, required/critical IDs and dependency data. Original custom IDs and conflicting critical definitions block mutation. 185 data members:45SLK29291rows,140profiles42352sections; pack source_game3.0.1.24360.

offline.definition-publish.name: Additive map/campaign upgrade with staged verification
offline.definition-publish.prior_decision: This is a map-authoring/deployment feature which changes object availability/version gates. Product retains read-only source extraction and separate safe report output; there is no mandate to create modified gameplay maps.
offline.definition-publish.reviewed_semantics: Recovers names from source strings by exact hash only, fingerprints all nonmetadata members plus flags, patches required tables in private copies, validates JASS function order, compacts and verifies decoded members, then publishes a uniquely named output/report/log. Source is rehashed and gameplay_tested=false is explicit.

offline.custom-talents.name: Live custom talent discovery with immutable binding
offline.custom-talents.prior_decision: Live profile adapter and game process proof are required; offline matrix does not claim current talent discovery. Fixed official tiers never replace custom map source evidence.
offline.custom-talents.reviewed_semantics: Builds official+map-defined controller catalog; level-zero attached ATal still exposes point data, represented as at least1 in the display snapshot. This is attached live-instance observation, not a static object-table parser.

offline.apply-artifact-plan.name: Apply six-item live inventory preset
offline.apply-artifact-plan.prior_decision: This mutates a selected game unit; w3xray inventory/query evidence remains read-only.
offline.apply-artifact-plan.reviewed_semantics: Delegates inventory ability addition and replacement to existing trainer services.

offline.loadout-operation-scope.name: Fresh inventory reads around equipment mutations
offline.loadout-operation-scope.prior_decision: The operation scope exists to support generated-equipment restoration and effect refresh. Its freshness/identity principle agrees with product live rules, but the mutation hooks are not reusable offline features.
offline.loadout-operation-scope.reviewed_semantics: Nested restore scopes must share the same target. Mutation snapshots are accepted only if complete target/bag/equipment/selection fields are present; otherwise a new snapshot is read.

offline.item-effect-read.name: Item-owned ability fields and protected controllers
offline.item-effect-read.prior_decision: Static item-to-ability links already exist in product. This service calls runtime natives and therefore needs the live audit's verified adapter, not a claim of offline equivalence.
offline.item-effect-read.reviewed_semantics: Captures unit/item/full/container identity, enumerates attached abilities, filters fields by effect class and supported level, records unsupported strings/arrays; batch size32 partitions requests rather than discarding remaining fields.

offline.item-effect-write.name: Expected-value guarded item ability field mutation
offline.item-effect-write.prior_decision: Changing item-attached skill fields is gameplay mutation; product only retains static linked skill values and uncertainty.
offline.item-effect-write.reviewed_semantics: Only an existing supported writable numeric row is accepted; expected before-value bits travel to native work, actual after-value is decoded and compared.

live.selection.canonical.name: 按玩家读取规范选择链及稳定性复核
live.selection.canonical.prior_decision: w3xray已有独立主选中单位/本地集合、回链/类型/计数/尾节点证据。3.0 sentinel与x64布局不可替换经典布局；不采纳24条产品上限。双采样稳定性是参考，不宣称已逐字移植。
live.selection.canonical.reviewed_semantics: 读取当前profile的manager/header/next/unit；校验空链tagged sentinel、完整count/tail、节点循环和重复单位；两次完整遍历及manager槽重读必须一致。它不负责寻找本地玩家或解析JASS句柄。

DISC-ABI-BODY.name: 完整函数体、寄存器来源与返回值检查
DISC-ABI-BODY.prior_decision: 可复用部分寄存器写入即清除来源和真实返回尾检查；不移植 x64 3.0 ABI、函数大小/步数上限，也不把少数 native 样本推广为全部 native。
DISC-ABI-BODY.reviewed_semantics: _register_family 将 8/16/32/64 位 GPR 别名归并；任意部分写入都会使指针来源失效。；_body 按 .pdata 函数范围读取并要求完整反汇编；拒绝特权/异常指令和跳出函数或进入非指令边界的跳转。；_unit_input_to_call 检查首个 call 前 RCX 未被破坏；_real_pointer 追踪复制与易失寄存器失效，查找实际四字节浮点解引用。；_return_epilogue 检查 AL/EAX 结果到实际 ret 期间未被改写，支持有限的直接 jmp。

DISC-ABI-AGGREGATE.name: 独立 primitive ABI 样本聚合
DISC-ABI-AGGREGATE.prior_decision: 保留调用约定确认与业务功能确认分开的分层；当前审计不把运行时样本转换为 w3xray 已支持的 Reforged 功能。
DISC-ABI-AGGREGATE.reviewed_semantics: 解析注册签名，仅对实数参数、实数/布尔返回和首个单位句柄参数的函数取证。；实数指针至少来自两个不同函数；实数 EAX 位模式返回和布尔 AL 返回各至少一个；单位标量输入至少两个不同函数。；合并 reviewed_real_pointer_callers 的被审 helper 闭包，按函数地址去重，不把共用 helper 计作两条独立证据。；每类最终最多保留两个不同站点的样本，缺任一类别返回 unresolved 并列出缺失类别。

live.discovery.ability-identity.name: 由完整handle与MSVC RTTI证明技能成员
live.discovery.ability-identity.prior_decision: 不直接移植x64 RTTI/布局；产品已有declared-layout-only/confirmed字段资格分离。真实3.0 skill read待独立验证。
live.discovery.ability-identity.reviewed_semantics: 验证COL签名、自相对RVA、基类CAbility descriptor与可执行方法；由规范组件wrapper的tag/fullhandle/data一致性，在多对象中求full_handle/vtable成员交集，并只重读身份字而不把动态计数变化误作身份改变。

DISC-ABI-CALLER-BODY.name: 预审 caller/helper 形状匹配
DISC-ABI-CALLER-BODY.prior_decision: 作为离线配方身份/形状核对参考；不可只移植遮罩特征后省略完整函数、call 和跳转复核。
DISC-ABI-CALLER-BODY.reviewed_semantics: 配方源码必须完整反汇编，所有内部跳转必须落在源码指令边界。；实际函数大小/指令数量一致；仅允许被 signature 遮蔽的位移变化，所有实际直接 call 仍需位于可执行映像。；实际内部跳转相对位置必须保持预审控制流。

DISC-ABI-CFG.name: 寄存器与栈槽来源 CFG
DISC-ABI-CFG.prior_decision: 可复用保守来源失效与每调用状态独立核对；固定状态/栈窗不能作为 w3xray 全量解析保证。
DISC-ABI-CFG.reviewed_semantics: 以入口 RSP 为坐标跟踪别名与八字节栈槽；调用时清除易失寄存器。；遇条件分支同时探索目标与落空路径，重复状态去重；完整/部分寄存器写入及重叠栈写入清除旧来源。；可在指定 call 前捕获每个可达传参状态；四字节解引用记录其来源参数。；复杂未支持的返回栈恢复停止该分支，不把它解释成另一个参数传递路径。

DISC-ABI-FORWARDERS.name: 固定名单的实数转发证明
DISC-ABI-FORWARDERS.prior_decision: 不迁入这两个会发出单位命令的 native 功能；可借鉴只读取代码也必须核对 helper 闭包的方法。
DISC-ABI-FORWARDERS.reviewed_semantics: 默认从 profiles/discovery/semantics.json 读取版本匹配配方，要求精确键集合。；只接受 GroupPointOrder 与 GroupPointOrderById，每 native 不能重复；签名必须与实时注册表相同。；配方必须指定两个不同、位于前四参数中的 R 参数与一个直接 call 指令。；caller 与 helper 都完成形状核对，再转换调用点栈偏移并逐个 CFG 状态确认两个参数均被 helper 读取。

live.discovery.component-graph.name: 规范组件双链与攻击成员的交叉证明
live.discovery.component-graph.prior_decision: 保留独立结构身份+语义消费者的交叉证明思想；不移植采样范围/3.0组件布局，也不将有限图发现改称全量枚举。
live.discovery.component-graph.reviewed_semantics: 每玩家规范group提供单位样本（不宣称选中语义）；寻找head/node/previous/next/owner/tag/handle/data唯一布局，要求多个owner/多个tag、规范registry身份和回读稳定。unit_attack先有native候选，再要求与Aatk组件data一致。

DISC-DECODER-ALGEBRA.name: 状态表达式与三值条件语义
DISC-DECODER-ALGEBRA.prior_decision: 可复用未知值/表达式保留思想；3.0 具体公式与常量需本产品独立证据。
DISC-DECODER-ALGEBRA.reviewed_semantics: 统一寄存器族，保留 64 位旋转与位掩码。；_normal 只接受 rol/xor/rol 或 xor/ror/rol 形状及可选末尾 add，标准化为 add1/rol/xor/ror/add2。；_flags/_condition 以真/假/未知表达标志位，未知条件不会被猜成某个分支。

DISC-DECODER-FLOW.name: 逐分支符号路径证明
DISC-DECODER-FLOW.prior_decision: 可复用不猜测分支、未知调用和洞页保留失败的模型；预算需要成为公开诊断，不能悄悄当成无解码器。
DISC-DECODER-FLOW.reviewed_semantics: 按实际 PC 单条解码，支持重叠指令流；使用完整状态和每路径祖先状态检测循环。；只有调用指定 player accessor 才算命中，RCX 必须仍是可标准化状态表达式；其他 call、间接跳转、未知写入或未知算术都拒绝整条见证。；保留受支持的寄存器部分宽度写入、push/pop/xchg、简单栈写入、旋转与常量运算；条件未知时探索两路。；ret 可以结束没有命中的路径，最终至少有一个已证明 accessor 路径才返回 hits。

DISC-DECODER-SELECT.name: 独立函数一致性与缓存锚点
DISC-DECODER-SELECT.prior_decision: 独立函数一致性值得借鉴；4096 候选停止与缺少截断披露不符合 w3xray 全量证据要求，不能原样采用。
DISC-DECODER-SELECT.reviewed_semantics: 在可执行段中匹配 RIP-load 与常量装载前缀，定位 .pdata 所在函数并执行 _trace。；按 (根,标准化公式) 聚合，每个身份至少两个独立函数；多个合格身份返回 ambiguous，零个返回 unresolved。；唯一身份生成解码配置和 legacy_layout_24332_v1 选择，并保存每个完整见证到 accessor 的字节锚点。；另从其中一条完整见证导出 producer 与 core 两个 code checks；低地址见证仅是锚点选择。

live.discovery.capability-dependencies.name: 按实际请求声明功能依赖
live.discovery.capability-dependencies.prior_decision: 产品字段支持检查已有声明/运行分离；不导入trainer写操作能力清单。native总审负责operation->protocol->service对照。
live.discovery.capability-dependencies.reviewed_semantics: COMMON/NATIVE/FIELDS等组成显式operation清单；ability/world/clone/selection/property-write/extension按action精化，隐式抬高HP/MP maximum提前列依赖；父组confirmed覆盖叶，单叶不能证明父。audit_inventory检查operation无遗漏。

DISC-FIELD-BINDING.name: 预审 native 链与错误尾绑定
DISC-FIELD-BINDING.prior_decision: 可复用精确 callee/角色绑定；不搬用 3.0 特定错误恢复 thunk，不将调用序号单独当业务证明。
DISC-FIELD-BINDING.reviewed_semantics: _AmbiguousConsumer 保留多个源站点；_bound_error_tails 仅认可六条固定 TLS 错误 thunk 形状和指定 jump。；_unit_state_root_mask 只允许四状态 dispatcher 的成对 mana 子对象位移变化。；_bound_consumer 要求固定 schema、精确 native 签名或唯一 unit_state_dispatcher，按完整函数链追踪指定直接 call。；可要求首 call 是已确认单位解析器；内部跳转相对位置固定，外部错误尾必须单独核对；多个消费者目标冲突不选首条。

DISC-FIELD-OPERANDS.name: 字段操作数角色解码
DISC-FIELD-OPERANDS.prior_decision: 可复用语义角色校验与不按 offset 数值巧合认同字段。
DISC-FIELD-OPERANDS.reviewed_semantics: 对 displacement/immediate/bit_mask/indexed_stride 四种转换校验 mnemonic、operand、base、width。；bit_mask 必须是 flags load→同寄存器 SHR→低位 TEST 1 的相邻角色链。；indexed_stride 必须是 index+index*2，再 array+scaled_index*4 的两条 LEA，推出 stride 12。

DISC-FIELD-HELPERS.name: 算术 helper 完整闭包
DISC-FIELD-HELPERS.prior_decision: 可复用闭包证据，不应只拿顶层 getter 一段 AOB 就认可字段语义。
DISC-FIELD-HELPERS.reviewed_semantics: helper 选择器必须落在直接 call；源 body 完整解码且以 ret 终结，所有跳转必须留在自身完整正文。；当前 helper 需是可执行映像内同大小函数，字节遮罩匹配且所有实际跳转相对位置一致。；去重后保留完整 helper 锚点。

DISC-FIELD-COORD-CONTRACT.name: 位置属性记录四成员契约
DISC-FIELD-COORD-CONTRACT.prior_decision: 可复用坐标两轴/记录边界一起证明；具体 fixed compiler shape 不可跨版本默认。
DISC-FIELD-COORD-CONTRACT.reviewed_semantics: 仅认 getter/setter 两个已审契约；X/Y selector 必须齐全。；四个成员需从同一记录起点连续每四字节排列；setter 的合并写入和地址引用必须对应同一个起点。；只返回允许变动的指令位移，栈/代理对象位移继续固定。

DISC-FIELD-CONSENSUS.name: 独立语义消费者共识
DISC-FIELD-CONSENSUS.prior_decision: 推荐复用冲突不可被较弱或后来的观察抹掉和独立字段证据；不原样采用任意条目上限，也不把 recipe coverage 当全部字段 coverage。
DISC-FIELD-CONSENSUS.reviewed_semantics: 验证 recipe ID 唯一、字段白名单、完整正文、指令边界及明确可变化的位移/立即数。；可经 native/consumer 双路径绑定同一函数；坐标契约要求 Get/SetUnitX 与配对 Y、固定父位移及算术 helper 闭包。；当前函数必须唯一且 .pdata 大小精确，内部跳转保持相对目的地；值范围有效。；每字段聚合所有成功消费者。任何冲突值或歧义消费者使字段 ambiguous；至少两个不同 ID、两个不同函数和全部 links 到齐才 confirmed；否则 unresolved。

DISC-FIELD-ARMOR.name: 原生护甲标量成员独立记录
DISC-FIELD-ARMOR.prior_decision: 直接可借鉴的语义边界：最终/缓存/基础护甲不可因名称相同混写。此审计未为 w3xray 增加实时护甲读取。
DISC-FIELD-ARMOR.reviewed_semantics: 仅观察 BlzGetUnitArmor，需精确签名、已确认单位解析器、一次 resolver call、固定 null 分支和 EAX 四字节返回。；生成 native_members.unit_armor 证明；updates 始终不写旧 external armor 字段。

DISC-FIELD-DIRECT-XY.name: 单位直接坐标 getter/setter 双证据
DISC-FIELD-DIRECT-XY.prior_decision: 可复用双向读写消费者只读取证，但不能把 setter 的存在解释为本产品授权写坐标。
DISC-FIELD-DIRECT-XY.reviewed_semantics: 按 X/Y 分别绑定精确 GetUnit/SetUnit 签名，要求首 call 到已确认 resolver，setter 只能有这一次 call。；追踪单位指针、R 参数指针、浮点位值与寄存器 clobber；setter 仅支持空单位退出分支。；getter 的真实 EAX 返回与 setter 写入同一成员、来自两个不同函数才 confirmed；不一致保持 ambiguous。

live.discovery.image-observation.name: 可读共享映像观察与磁盘RTTI名字
live.discovery.image-observation.prior_decision: 不为了补齐3.0受保护页引入共享handle映射通道；产品当前普通只读进程快照/PE身份策略可继续工作，缺页保留诊断。
live.discovery.image-observation.reviewed_semantics: 尝试复制目标已有Section handle到本进程，FILE_MAP_READ映射观察，并以大小/PE指纹/运行中主模块header一致性筛选；finally unmap/close。失败回普通可读页capture。磁盘非代码可读section查MSVC TypeDescriptor名字，输出RVA。

DISC-LOCATOR-SEARCH.name: 指令遮罩与候选搜索
DISC-LOCATOR-SEARCH.prior_decision: 可复用指令级而非裸字节位移提取；搜索预算/丢失后缀必须明确诊断，不能照搬空列表即无匹配的表达。
DISC-LOCATOR-SEARCH.reviewed_semantics: signature 仅遮蔽 RIP/调用/跳转重定位或显式允许的字段/立即数，保留 opcode/寄存器角色。；matches 优先最长固定字节锚点再完整遮罩比较；否则在 executable segments 用正向预查找保留重叠候选。；rip_targets 在真实指令操作数上提取映像内 RVA；locate_reference 以 recipe 调用这套搜索。

DISC-LOCATOR-RTTI.name: MSVC RTTI 主对象 vtable 身份
DISC-LOCATOR-RTTI.prior_decision: 可复用无绝对地址的缓存身份见证；不把三方法锚点当全部类虚函数语义证明。
DISC-LOCATOR-RTTI.reviewed_semantics: 从类名或已取得 TypeDescriptor 候选找 x64 COL，核对 signature、主对象 offset、self RVA 与 hierarchy。；再找指向 COL 的对齐指针，前三个 methods 必须位于可执行映像。；见证仅保存 RVA/COL 原始 bytes/相对 method RVA，避免缓存绝对地址。

DISC-LOCATOR-DECODE-SHAPE.name: 固定顺序状态解码片段
DISC-LOCATOR-DECODE-SHAPE.prior_decision: 只作已审公式的识别参考，不自动扩展到陌生 decoder。
DISC-LOCATOR-DECODE-SHAPE.reviewed_semantics: 仅解释 legacy、modern_tail、modern 三种 rol/ror/add/xor 顺序，要求操作目标一致且常量来源可追踪。；modern 的第二次 ROL 规范化成 ROR；此函数暂置 add2=0，但上层必须走独立完整数据流路径，不直接使用该零值。

DISC-LOCATOR-ORCHESTRATION.name: 依赖分离的发现总编排
DISC-LOCATOR-ORCHESTRATION.prior_decision: 推荐复用 capability/dependency 分层，避免整份相近 profile 一次性授权所有偏移。
DISC-LOCATOR-ORCHESTRATION.reviewed_semantics: 分别收集 resolver/registry root、code checks、TLS、状态根、RTTI、stat模式、公共布局和字段语义。；registry root 需要 resolver 的双 RIP 引用；单一引用会被撤回。；受保护 callee 可用两个独立调用点补充；字段结果通过冲突合并规则进入全局 evidence。

DISC-LOCATOR-REGISTRY.name: 双句柄分支结构与 generation 候选
DISC-LOCATOR-REGISTRY.prior_decision: generation 高位不是完整 handle 的充分证据；这是本轮 handle confidence/identity 改进的关联参考，具体实现由负责 agent 验证。
DISC-LOCATOR-REGISTRY.reviewed_semantics: 在 resolver 的两分支上分别提取 root 下的 table/count、slot owner 与 generation compare。；两个分支的 count相对偏移、owner、generation 必须一致且符合支持步幅形状。；输出 registry primary/alternate/count/stride/slot_owner 已确认值；相邻完整 owner_handle 只标 candidate，等待当前玩家 backlink。

DISC-LOCATOR-NATIVE-RESOLVER.name: typed native 呼叫解析器证据
DISC-LOCATOR-NATIVE-RESOLVER.prior_decision: 借鉴调用者/被调用者交叉核对；无法据此免除 Reforged 具体 build/profile 验证。
DISC-LOCATOR-NATIVE-RESOLVER.reviewed_semantics: 检查 GetUnitTypeId/GetUnitPointValue/GetUnitX/GetUnitY 的精确签名和完整受支持正文，RCX 句柄需原样到首 call。；通常要求两个不同 caller 同一目标；GetUnitTypeId 还可用固定 resolver prologue 和直接 type-id load 交叉补证。；随后交由 direct coordinates 与 recovery 模块分别证明坐标/错误尾，不把偶然 load 直接当坐标。

DISC-LOCATOR-PUBLIC.name: TLS 与玩家数组布局提取
DISC-LOCATOR-PUBLIC.prior_decision: 可复用槽号由消费指令证明的思路；这些数值边界不能替代本产品实际结构边界与全量诊断。
DISC-LOCATOR-PUBLIC.reviewed_semantics: 从已匹配 context caller 跟随唯一 call，在有界 accessor 中找 TLS index load 与 indexed list header。；mode slot 来源于 caller 的显式 ECX 立即数，mode_bridge/object/value 来自固定数据流形状。；玩家 count/array/max_count 与 local player index 各自从 typed accessor 的边界/索引消费提取，写出对应 code checks。

DISC-LOCATOR-STATE.name: 状态解码候选与真实玩家消费者
DISC-LOCATOR-STATE.prior_decision: 保留相同数值与同一业务对象的区分；不搬固定窗口或宣称完整跨编译器支持。
DISC-LOCATOR-STATE.reviewed_semantics: 候选来自三类固定 decoder signature；modern split add2 不猜零，交完整 flow 证明。；多身份时可用两个不同函数把同一 RBX 来源作为 RCX 送到玩家 accessor 来消歧；第二合格身份仍冲突。；多个等价站点仅选一个作为精确字节锚点，值身份仍由所有记录去重；不能解释为按首条猜答案。

DISC-LOCATOR-ABI.name: 数学 native与备用原始ABI证据
DISC-LOCATOR-ABI.prior_decision: 不应为只读探针引入执行桥；这里只可借鉴证据分层。
DISC-LOCATOR-ABI.reviewed_semantics: 优先 SquareRoot 的真实 R 指针解引用和 EAX位返回、独立 Boolean AL 返回、GetUnitTypeId scalar句柄输入。；三者必须来自不同地址；任何一类不成立走 typed_native_abi_evidence 备用观察。；明确只建立共享 primitive封送，不建立每个native业务语义。

DISC-LOCATOR-CALL-SITES.name: 受保护 callee 的双调用点相关
DISC-LOCATOR-CALL-SITES.prior_decision: 可借鉴不选首候选和目标冲突保留；再由独立身份与操作依赖复核。
DISC-LOCATOR-CALL-SITES.reviewed_semantics: 每个已知调用点配方必须在当前映像唯一匹配且从直接 call 开始。；按目标收集独立配方索引，至少两个来源才成为候选；有多个合格目标则保持 ambiguous。

DISC-LOCATOR-ATTACK.name: 基础冷却组件候选
DISC-LOCATOR-ATTACK.prior_decision: 推荐复用 candidate分层与base/effective概念区分；本审计未增加实时攻击速度能力。
DISC-LOCATOR-ATTACK.reviewed_semantics: 只观察 BlzGetUnitAttackCooldown(Hunit;I)R，支持武器索引 guard 后原样传单位句柄。；追踪resolver返回单位、单位成员组件、组件call返回指针与最终四字节EAX返回。；输出 bridge_layout.unit_attack candidate；之后必须由 Aatk registry identity 才能升级。；明示返回值是 BASE cooldown，不能替代有效攻击间隔或实际攻击速度。

live.discovery.native-bootstrap.name: 当前窗口TLS绑定的原生注册发现
live.discovery.native-bootstrap.prior_decision: 不将这个3.0 bootstrap或native执行能力加入产品。当前matrix仅承认被动发现逻辑可供研究，跨版本语义和传递调用交native审计。
live.discovery.native-bootstrap.reviewed_semantics: 优先实际窗口TLS有限槽查规范Native表；旧layout无效才以name/signature/executable handler/terminal图唯一推断，fresh NativeTable重读确认。heap字符串只是候选，必须关联唯一active TLS slot，且窗口TID/PID/TLS稳定。不持久化live pointer。

DISC-RECOVERY-ENVELOPE.name: typed native 读取包络
DISC-RECOVERY-ENVELOPE.prior_decision: 保留来源包络关联；不能把声明的读取包络当任意错误恢复点授权。
DISC-RECOVERY-ENVELOPE.reviewed_semantics: 先核对注册名/精确签名与可执行地址。primary模式使用 .pdata 函数范围；保护页多片段模式使用下一已注册handler作为上界。

DISC-RECOVERY-LOCAL-PLAYER.name: 本地玩家normal/alternate索引
DISC-RECOVERY-LOCAL-PLAYER.prior_decision: 适合作为不猜local玩家的参考；不能默认最近版本索引或固定玩家槽。
DISC-RECOVERY-LOCAL-PLAYER.reviewed_semantics: 要求context mode predicate和player accessor各自已确认并复读code check。；GetLocalPlayer中固定8指令分支形状必须call已知predicate、按AL分支、加载两个不同16位索引并call已知accessor。；分别聚合normal/alternate并用unique_evidence处理冲突。

DISC-RECOVERY-TAILS.name: 雾与技能等级恢复偏移
DISC-RECOVERY-TAILS.prior_decision: 不为w3xray只读读取引入fog/技能修改或SEH恢复；仅记录为native协议审计交叉依赖。
DISC-RECOVERY-TAILS.reviewed_semantics: FogEnable/FogMaskEnable/IsFogEnabled/IsFogMaskEnabled各自按固定R14清零/空读/尾部字节取证，六个leaf齐全才有fog_recovery组。；SetUnitAbilityLevel只接受明确R12空读后结果计算及epilogue的已审pattern。；reconcile保持子项冲突/缺失为unresolved；仅完整code/static identity的既有组可按规则保留。

live.discovery.property-graph.name: 属性容器语法与身份成员发现
live.discovery.property-graph.prior_decision: 产品已有字段source/bytes/qualification/conflict与资源校准；不引入未经本产品验证的3.0容器layout。
live.discovery.property-graph.reviewed_semantics: 在owner范围查array/mirror/capacity/stride/count descriptor；多玩家PROPERTY_TAG、owner回链、packed state身份及state_identity_stride共同约束，求唯一schema并身份字复读。snapshot bounds仅在tag/handle/owner/kind/value各成员confirmed后按实际跨度推导。

live.discovery.selection-role.name: 规范玩家集合与native选择语义相互印证
live.discovery.selection-role.prior_decision: 产品已有classic独立主指针/完整集合且缺layout时明确降级；不将3.0 group推测或两种mode偏移移入产品。
live.discovery.selection-role.reviewed_semantics: 分析IsUnitSelected/GroupEnumUnitsSelected的带类型注册及指令数据流寻找player manager；consumer不一致保留ambiguous；graph要每个玩家链有效且至少一条非空、单位registry身份有效并重读；唯一group也仅candidate，需native角色证明。local仅校验当前已证mode index。

DISC-STAT-CAPABILITY.name: 统计模块依赖与冲突协调
DISC-STAT-CAPABILITY.prior_decision: 可复用按实际依赖启用能力以及冲突反向撤销组；不要把native ABI成功等同全部属性可用。
DISC-STAT-CAPABILITY.reviewed_semantics: stat_details需NATIVE、stat_runtime、flat_flag、ability/component布局及四类stat_mode全部confirmed，并只能选择已知打包implementation。；任何leaf ambiguous撤销stat_runtime组；完整类模式必须与flat_flag候选一致。

DISC-STAT-METHOD.name: class-bound完整方法与DataB角色
DISC-STAT-METHOD.prior_decision: 可复用类身份+生产者/序列化者双语义，不复制硬编码slot或用数值碰巧一样认字段。
DISC-STAT-METHOD.reviewed_semantics: initializer要求DataB读取产生浮点比较，非零/无序→AL1、零→AL0并写同一字节；serializer必须按固定寄存器角色读取该字节。；特定额外xor r9d变体保留完整语义并映射回原指令位置。；只能绑定vtable slot36 initializer/slot15 serializer；完整函数大小、遮罩、内外分支、call可执行目标都需一致。；法术增幅相邻第二flag必须继续相邻，不能独立漂移。

DISC-STAT-CONSENSUS.name: 四类双消费者共识
DISC-STAT-CONSENSUS.prior_decision: 可复用不以多数投票掩盖类间冲突；本审计未声称w3xray已经具备这些Reforged属性。
DISC-STAT-CONSENSUS.reviewed_semantics: 每个class rule必须精确类名且唯一，恰好initializer/serializer两个方法。；每类两个不同函数返回同偏移才confirmed；四类模式与四类RTTI都confirmed且同一个偏移，才产出flat_flag和stat_runtime组。；原始候选和方法/完整字节锚点在歧义或缺失时保留。

DISC-VALIDATE-SELECTION.name: 选择列表读取与native语义分级
DISC-VALIDATE-SELECTION.prior_decision: 推荐复用可读取与可执行能力分开；不能把只读图成立变成native mutation许可。
DISC-VALIDATE-SELECTION.reviewed_semantics: confirm_selection要求native consumer confirmed且live rings的candidate/confirmed指向完全相同成员。；confirm_selection_read允许当前map已验证非空canonical rings单独批准外部读取；protected native本身不阻止被动列表遍历。；任何native歧义或冲突会否决读取；refresh通过共享merge维护冲突，不让随后不可读观察抹去矛盾。；selection.read_only与整个selection capability是不同组。

DISC-VALIDATE-OWNER.name: 完整handle backlink复核
DISC-VALIDATE-OWNER.prior_decision: 直接关联本轮handle identity/confidence任务：保留generation提示与完整身份确证的区别。
DISC-VALIDATE-OWNER.reviewed_semantics: generation邻近字段只为candidate；仅当候选等于bootstrap已用owner_handle成员时，复读每个player完整handle并经registry解析owner再比对backlink。；新member与现有bootstrap不同直接拒绝，因为已有player图未用新member，不能循环自证。

DISC-VALIDATE-COMMON.name: 当前map公共依赖只读验证
DISC-VALIDATE-COMMON.prior_decision: 可复用probe配置不进入操作后端、当前map重验证与分组证据；不能把static discovery完结当运行时已验证。
DISC-VALIDATE-COMMON.reviewed_semantics: context和checks只在其所有declared leaf confirmed后聚合。；构造仅用于图探测的GameProfile，将module指纹绑定当前指纹但不交给执行/写后端；在profile_scope里读取真实registry与所有players。；逐层补property、resource span、owner_handle、selection、component链、Aatk和ability identity证明。；只有resolver为confirmed instruction_shape且live owner图成立才确认registry；再有decoder才确认legacy_layout模块。；DiscoveryError透传；普通读失败保留registry_live或component组unresolved及原因，不换为成功。

live.profile.schema.name: 只读数据档案、严格布局/ABI校验与原子导入
live.profile.schema.prior_decision: w3xray已有自己的schema-v1严格校验、档案导入/导出与声明覆盖检查。保留自身兼容格式；不接受trainer schema5作为运行档案，不引入任意代码加载。
live.profile.schema.reviewed_semantics: JSON重复键拒绝；递归类型/键/数组形状精确匹配；v4转v5仅表示升级；校验坐标/物品记录/组件/属性描述符/资源/六槽布局、RVA与指纹；ABI固定到编译模板，模块只选打包实现。候选不能安装，validated通过临时文件+replace发布；ContextVar隔离活动档案。

live.profile.nearest.name: 最近版本配置仅作为发现来源
live.profile.nearest.prior_decision: 不将nearest自动借用移入产品。w3xray未知x64保持reforged-pending，经典版现场推导与诊断另行完成。
live.profile.nearest.reviewed_semantics: 精确fingerprint优先，多个同版本档案用唯一最高adapter revision；否则按同架构/major.minor的patch/build距离选最近来源，平距偏早build再新revision；仅认可Warcraft III.exe/war3.exe名字并核对磁盘版本来源。借用档案状态明确borrowed。

live.session.identity.name: 进程实例、地图上下文与有类型对象身份
live.session.identity.prior_decision: w3xray已有进程创建时间/路径交付复核与静态快照身份；本轮另agent正在强化句柄完整读取和回链，语义相通。未复制trainer的x64 Session/对象wrapper框架。
live.session.identity.reviewed_semantics: PID+创建FILETIME+模块基址+PE指纹+profile digest建立会话；TLS/窗口/registry/state/native head改变推进epoch并清缓存；对象引用携完整handle、地址、rawcode，resolve再次核对所有权、代次和类别；显式删除item进入当前epoch墓碑集合。

live.session.dispatch-evidence.name: 分离原生调用送达、回读、效果与清理证据
live.session.dispatch-evidence.prior_decision: 只采纳证据分层原则；w3xray不需要原生dispatch/远程分配生命周期，不引入写入会话。协议/清理由native矩阵承接。
live.session.dispatch-evidence.reviewed_semantics: finish分别记录delivered/callback_exited/readback_verified/effect_verified/cleanup_complete/uncertain；未退出callback或未清理分配保留dispatch，后续native请求受阻；结束会话尝试关闭owned resources并保留失败证据。业务失败自身不是永久写入禁令。

live.pe.version-source.name: 磁盘PE身份与版本资源一致性
live.pe.version-source.prior_decision: 本轮另agent已在工作树实现独立PE资源解析和磁盘/内存头前后核对；这里仅静态核对可见代码，不认领测试结果。
live.pe.version-source.reviewed_semantics: 从磁盘DOS/PE头取machine/timestamp/SizeOfImage；调用Windows版本资源API并校验VS_FIXEDFILEINFO magic；缓存以path/mtime_ns/size区分，版本读取前后stat稳定且磁盘指纹必须等于预期加载映像。

live.access.integrity.name: 按方向比较Windows完整性级别
live.access.integrity.prior_decision: w3xray已有token RID读取和live前置诊断；无需导入trainer ctypes全局或提权动作。
live.access.integrity.reviewed_semantics: 只申请QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION/TOKEN_QUERY，读SID最终subauthority；允许高权限trainer读较低权限game，只在已知trainer RID低于game时拒绝并附report。查询不成功保留unknown。

live.native.journal.name: 原生调用环形证据payload解码
live.native.journal.prior_decision: 不加入原生调用采集器；w3xray已有每次被动探针journal。此固定ABI模型交native协议矩阵，作为日志分层参考。
live.native.journal.reviewed_semantics: 构建/校验固定workbuffer，解码37个native类型、phase、入/返标志、参数、原始返回位、最后调用；明确记录容量/丢失/完整性和仅已观察调用的证据范围。自身不调用游戏。

live.native.entry-preflight.name: 原生handler映像归属与映射保护核对
live.native.entry-preflight.prior_decision: w3xray纯读无需原生handler执行前置；保留自身profile bytes与映像证据。其protected-image opt-in不可成为产品执行通道。
live.native.entry-preflight.reviewed_semantics: 内存PE身份匹配当前profile；handler span需位于声明可执行section内，VirtualQueryEx确认allocation/state/type/范围；readable-executable可采代码，NOACCESS仅显式diagnostic-opt-in且不读代码。

live.native.registration-read.name: 帧上下文原生注册链读取与缓存复核
live.native.registration-read.prior_decision: 不导入3.0注册布局/handler表；版本及协议承接native审计。产品不需要执行native来读已支持classic数据。
live.native.registration-read.reviewed_semantics: 从context5嵌入表按profile字段读到tagged terminal；名称/签名ASCII字符串按页读取、必要时同位单字节重读；拒绝循环、重复name、非法handler/签名，前后head一致。缓存复核handler和signature内容。

live.registry.identity.name: 完整handle代次、双注册表和对象回链
live.registry.identity.prior_decision: 本轮另agent强化产品classic句柄精确读取、generation/alive/object及对象自身handle回链；保留产品全表完整性与失败诊断，不照搬经验count上限。
live.registry.identity.reviewed_semantics: low高位选primary/alternate，索引受表声明count约束；slot live marker、owner full_handle、table/slot/root前后重读；unit类别与owner_data双向对应；players验证每个player身份并重读count/array/state，local按已证明mode index取玩家。

live.registry.module-identity.name: 模块枚举、已验证PE和启动重试
live.registry.module-identity.prior_decision: 本轮产品模块枚举按API字节数扩容并保留complete/diagnostics、加载头前后核对；不采纳4096/96经验数量截断或仅名字授权。
live.registry.module-identity.reviewed_semantics: PSAPI动态需求与Toolhelp交叉补充，按已验证PE找game image而非只看文件名；初始化再核fingerprint+resolver/player accessor bytes；仅未加载模块错误有短暂重试；受profile控制的不可读code check例外会留标志。

live.resources.indexed.name: 3.0带类型标签的玩家属性读取入口
live.resources.indexed.prior_decision: w3xray已有classic资源链、HUD校准和完整候选证据；不复制3.0标签/偏移。该adapter具体读取由native适配矩阵承接，3.0真实支持仍待独立采集。
live.resources.indexed.reviewed_semantics: 固定PROPERTY_TAG/PLAYER_TAG与六个required state，选registry.profile或current_profile后委派adapter.properties.player_properties。该薄包装自身无写入或扫描。

live.discovery.infrastructure.name: 明确候选状态、映像缺页与发现中断边界
live.discovery.infrastructure.prior_decision: 产品已有阶段进度、取消/预算状态与字段置信度；产品默认完整扫描、不采用源固定时间/候选上限作为常规完备性。
live.discovery.infrastructure.reviewed_semantics: 不可变evidence保存dependency/state/method/candidates/anchors/detail；ScanBudget支持取消/进度/累计读取；捕获PE可读非写section，块读失败退页读并保存holes而不补零；pdata给函数边界；unique_evidence区分零/唯一/多候选。

live.discovery.cache.name: 内容身份绑定的发现缓存
live.discovery.cache.prior_decision: 保留按真实输入指纹重验证原则，w3xray已有自有pack/报告身份体系；不移植trainer专属discovery缓存或用户目录。
live.discovery.cache.reviewed_semantics: 未知build才全文件SHA；缓存key含调用方identity，payload SHA排除自身哈希；重复JSON键拒绝，原子写入；rdata指针相对基址归一化后可比较静态内容。

live.discovery.resolution.name: 按已证依赖构造未知版本配置
live.discovery.resolution.prior_decision: 不把整个未知3.0发现器纳入产品或声称x64支持。w3xray继续显式声明字段与运行资格分离，未知字段保留unknown；算法源可参考，但需独立fixtures/实机证明。
live.discovery.resolution.reviewed_semantics: 精确命中在任何发现I/O前返回；未知build需要recipe版本和source digest吻合，映像身份与多类独立观察合并。unresolved不抹掉先前confirmed，相反证据变ambiguous且移除值；更新仅允许预审语义路径，模块算法/ABI不由JSON引入。COMMON齐备后缓存，细项按request依赖启用。

live.discovery.cache-recheck.name: 缓存命中仍重核完整锚点与当前地图对象图
live.discovery.cache-recheck.prior_decision: 采纳缓存不能替代当前身份的原则，产品现有profile字节/字段证据核验仍使用自有格式。未实现trainer的RTTI+TLS缓存重建。
live.discovery.cache-recheck.reviewed_semantics: 逐update检查confirmed候选与值相等；所有code checks及语义anchor完整字节重读；mode-vtable链接、RTTI COL/方法地址按当前基址复核；selection/property/component/attack/ability图须在当前地图重证，旧地图关系不可作为build不变事实。

live.compat.entrypoint.name: 历史模块兼容入口
live.compat.entrypoint.prior_decision: 不采纳入口shim；w3xray保留自己的main/GUI/CLI。其应用路径交frontend与native总审。
live.compat.entrypoint.reviewed_semantics: __main__调用war3_app.main；被导入时将历史名指向war3_backend，并绑定GUI/CLI/theme/i18n兼容名称。if分支内theme函数不在旧index符号表，但完整源已阅读并在新定义清单保留。

live.remote.exports.name: 目标进程PE导出/forwarder/API-set解析
live.remote.exports.prior_decision: 产品纯读无需远程LoadLibrary/系统导出执行链；不引入这个执行基础设施。保留PE解析身份原则，具体调用消费者交native总审。
live.remote.exports.reviewed_semantics: 从read callback解析目标PE32/PE32+导出表；名称或ordinal定位，forwarder递归跟踪与循环拒绝；API-set v6从目标namespace按importer别名/唯一default/hashed prefix解析，绝不拿本机shim地址重定位。只解析数据，不调用返回地址。

live.runtime.bundle-check.name: 打包runtime自检入口（仅静态审读）
live.runtime.bundle-check.prior_decision: 不运行历史包、不加载目标DLL；产品自己的打包/acceptance测试负责自身依赖。其临时目录隔离理念与产品既有测试纪律一致。
live.runtime.bundle-check.reviewed_semantics: 执行时会导入capstone、GUI/解析服务，并加载MPQ DLL，验证bundle内decoder/DLL路径hash、反汇编指令边界、存档/背包定义和临时偏好保存。它不挂游戏hook，但并非只读文本校验器。

live.selection.failure-evidence.name: 规范选择失败后的被动证据
live.selection.failure-evidence.prior_decision: 产品已有结构化选择/字段/句柄源地址与完整失败诊断；不复制固定偏移或16条诊断截断。坚持事后观察不能覆盖先前失败。
live.selection.failure-evidence.reviewed_semantics: 读候选owner/unit/handle三项身份、两个属性表descriptor与每个观测节点的地址/标签/owner/kind，保存读错误、foreign_owner、重复等；前后身份与descriptor再读。

live.handoff.service.__init__.name: Feature-domain services exposed through the backwards-compatible engine facade.
live.handoff.service.__init__.reviewed_semantics: Package marker only; no game or file operations.

live.handoff.service.abilities.name: abilities operations; transport and lifecycle belong to GameSession.
live.handoff.service.abilities.prior_decision: 技能/效果的action=0仍进游戏线程；不导入bridge。
live.handoff.service.abilities.reviewed_semantics: Service wrappers dispatch direct_cast / ability / ability_field / effect / world_effect / world_cast via _execute; action-zero reads still cross game-thread bridge.

live.handoff.service.ability_bundle.name: Sequential skill bundles: report a rejected skill and continue independent ones.
live.handoff.service.ability_bundle.prior_decision: 逐技能mutating执行与失败分类由native总审；只取独立失败诊断思想。
live.handoff.service.ability_bundle.reviewed_semantics: run_indexed_bundle dispatches action=1 sequentially; only released/rejected skills can be skipped after callback-exited and cleanup evidence; no failed request replay.

live.handoff.service.archive_fields.name: Read-only campaign cache files and session-bound selected-hero snapshots.
live.handoff.service.archive_fields.prior_decision: 离线缓存读取可沿产品save/wgc链使用；current英雄快照进入native，不当作被动读取。
live.handoff.service.archive_fields.reviewed_semantics: File archive reads are separate from read_current_heroes, which binds native units and executes hero/item/extension bridge queries. Exports create new files.

live.handoff.service.artifact_plan.name: Apply a captured six-slot plan through the existing inventory service.
live.handoff.service.artifact_plan.prior_decision: 添加AInv并替换六槽计划是游戏写入，不采纳。
live.handoff.service.artifact_plan.reviewed_semantics: apply_artifact_plan adds AInv then replaces selected inventory; no read-only route.

live.handoff.service.backpack_carrier.name: Bind and inspect the actual official backpack item before repairing its host.
live.handoff.service.backpack_carrier.prior_decision: inspect可能补加item ability；无无条件被动读取资格。
live.handoff.service.backpack_carrier.reviewed_semantics: inspect_backpack_carrier can attach missing item abilities with action=1 after identity and preservation checks; inspect is not passive.

live.handoff.service.backpack_interface.name: Complete missing official backpack components on the same bound target.
live.handoff.service.backpack_interface.prior_decision: 自动补齐/激活背包组件修改游戏，不采纳。
live.handoff.service.backpack_interface.reviewed_semantics: ensure_backpack_interface queries extension then adds/activates missing components via ability_batch action=1; partial state retained and reported.

live.handoff.service.batch_edit.name: Batch unit fields through the shared session and the existing field backends.
live.handoff.service.batch_edit.prior_decision: 局部数据模型可参考；读取经native绑定，apply是字段写入，不导入。
live.handoff.service.batch_edit.reviewed_semantics: Immutable snapshot/model helpers are local; read groups native bindings/stats/field calls; apply invokes identity-bound setters and records success/skipped/failed/not_attempted without replay.

live.handoff.service.camera_projection.name:
Warcraft screen projection, independent of process layout and transport.

The Warcraft camera is off-axis. Its native FOV is not the vertical angle
expected by a conventional tan(FOV/2) projection. The calibration and field
semantics here follow Antares' World2Screen 2.0 (September 19, 2026).
Source and executable-reference verification: docs/MOUSE_PROJECTION.md.
live.handoff.service.camera_projection.prior_decision: 纯数学校准依赖实际camera语义；产品已有地图坐标查询，无需求或独立渲染校准证据，不宣称可用。
live.handoff.service.camera_projection.reviewed_semantics: Finite camera-ray projection of provided values; diagnostics explicitly say not calibrated against game render; no process access.

live.handoff.service.cursor.name: Read a physical viewport without restoring or focusing the game window.
live.handoff.service.cursor.prior_decision: 宿主窗口/鼠标只读但临时改变调用线程DPI；产品现有截图按PID/窗口复核，未移植鼠标定位。
live.handoff.service.cursor.reviewed_semantics: Win32 viewport/cursor observations; temporarily changes caller-thread DPI awareness and restores it, without game focus or game-memory write.

live.handoff.service.effect_lifetime.name: A held effect belongs to one session and one typed source identity.
live.handoff.service.effect_lifetime.prior_decision: 施法、保持和finally cleanup可写游戏，不加入只读工具。
live.handoff.service.effect_lifetime.reviewed_semantics: Cast/hold/observe/cleanup lifecycle; cleanup can execute in finally and uncertain cleanup blocks further writes. Verification distinguishes command delivery from actual effect.

live.handoff.service.equipment_effects.name: Ordinary items use native equip/remove; object classification belongs to a session.
live.handoff.service.equipment_effects.prior_decision: classification/preflight可创建移除临时item，不加入被动探针。
live.handoff.service.equipment_effects.reviewed_semantics: preflight_creation creates/removes a temporary item through item_safety; classification can therefore mutate. Equip/repair/destroy/transfer use equipment_effect bridge.

live.handoff.service.equipment_slots.name: Bound nested exact-slot placement; the scope ends with this one operation.
live.handoff.service.equipment_slots.prior_decision: 仅operation-local ContextVar guard；其需求来自装备写入，产品无需。
live.handoff.service.equipment_slots.reviewed_semantics: ContextVar scoped exact-slot recursion/collision guard; mutates only local context and always resets token.

live.handoff.service.extension_definitio.name: Offline, additive 3.0 object definitions; archive originals are never edited.
live.handoff.service.extension_definitio.prior_decision: 离线staged表变换不是读取功能；源archive不变理念可参考，地图改写未采纳。
live.handoff.service.extension_definitio.reviewed_semantics: Hashes and validates bundled data then copies and modifies staged map/archive tables. Original source is verified unchanged; operation is offline transformation, not read-only parsing.

live.handoff.service.extensions.name: extensions operations; transport and lifecycle belong to GameSession.
live.handoff.service.extensions.prior_decision: extension/stat_details read也走bridge；talent_order发命令，不导入。
live.handoff.service.extensions.reviewed_semantics: equipment/extension/stat_details action-dependent bridge operations; talent_order issues a native order. Names/query labels do not confer passivity.

live.handoff.service.facade_abilities.name: abilities compatibility API; host primitives are explicitly bound once at composition.
live.handoff.service.facade_abilities.prior_decision: native查询/写入/legacy disabled支路混合；按native逐函数矩阵保留，不复制兼容facade。
live.handoff.service.facade_abilities.reviewed_semantics: native查询/写入/legacy disabled支路混合；按native逐函数矩阵保留，不复制兼容facade。

live.handoff.service.facade_binding.name:
Bind compatibility services to the existing host API, without a circular import.

No code is read, compiled or loaded from an adapter pack. The service functions
are ordinary bundled Python definitions. Sharing the explicit host namespace
preserves existing low-level API substitutions and avoids two global caches.
live.handoff.service.facade_binding.prior_decision: 只绑定固定host namespace，但下游能力属于native；产品使用自有模块边界。
live.handoff.service.facade_binding.reviewed_semantics: 只绑定固定host namespace，但下游能力属于native；产品使用自有模块边界。

live.handoff.service.facade_extensions.name: extensions compatibility API; host primitives are explicitly bound once at composition.

live.handoff.service.facade_fields.name: fields compatibility API; host primitives are explicitly bound once at composition.
live.handoff.service.facade_fields.prior_decision: 字段查询包含native transport，写入含readback/rollback；不能由read名称分类；完整职责归native矩阵。
live.handoff.service.facade_fields.reviewed_semantics: 字段查询包含native transport，写入含readback/rollback；不能由read名称分类；完整职责归native矩阵。

live.handoff.service.facade_items.name: items compatibility API; host primitives are explicitly bound once at composition.
live.handoff.service.facade_items.prior_decision: 物品读/写facade包含native与direct-memory路径；产品只保留自有库存/字段证据。
live.handoff.service.facade_items.reviewed_semantics: 物品读/写facade包含native与direct-memory路径；产品只保留自有库存/字段证据。

live.handoff.service.facade_native.name: native compatibility API; host primitives are explicitly bound once at composition.
live.handoff.service.facade_native.prior_decision: native executor/旧helper路由和失败清理属于执行基础设施，不导入。
live.handoff.service.facade_native.reviewed_semantics: native executor/旧helper路由和失败清理属于执行基础设施，不导入。

live.handoff.service.facade_resources.name: resources compatibility API; host primitives are explicitly bound once at composition.
live.handoff.service.facade_resources.prior_decision: 资源缓存、查询与写入混合；产品已有独立classic链/HUD扫描，不套用3.0 native资源setter。
live.handoff.service.facade_resources.reviewed_semantics: 资源缓存、查询与写入混合；产品已有独立classic链/HUD扫描，不套用3.0 native资源setter。

live.handoff.service.facade_selection.name: selection compatibility API; host primitives are explicitly bound once at composition.
live.handoff.service.facade_selection.prior_decision: 规范native路径、旧启发扫描、禁用路径需区分；产品已有完整classic选择/单位清单，不复制旧经验范围和首匹配。
live.handoff.service.facade_selection.reviewed_semantics: 规范native路径、旧启发扫描、禁用路径需区分；产品已有完整classic选择/单位清单，不复制旧经验范围和首匹配。

live.handoff.service.facade_units.name: units compatibility API; host primitives are explicitly bound once at composition.
live.handoff.service.facade_units.prior_decision: native binding、hero/position/spawn/clone调用，产品已用被动句柄链；不加入写入能力。
live.handoff.service.facade_units.reviewed_semantics: native binding、hero/position/spawn/clone调用，产品已用被动句柄链；不加入写入能力。

live.handoff.service.gold_mines.name: Mine resources through the session's existing native execution backend.
live.handoff.service.gold_mines.reviewed_semantics: amount None selects action=0; amount selects action=1; both call engine._execute gold_mine.

live.handoff.service.item_effect_fields.name: Bound item-owned abilities: capture the source once, then revalidate each query.
live.handoff.service.item_effect_fields.prior_decision: 绑定对象查询依然进bridge，setter有失败latch；不当成静态物品属性。
live.handoff.service.item_effect_fields.reviewed_semantics: capture binds through bridge and snapshots item/extension; read/query invoke item_effect bridge; write action=1 checks prior value and disables later writes after uncertain cleanup.

live.handoff.service.items.name: items operations; transport and lifecycle belong to GameSession.
live.handoff.service.items.prior_decision: item_catalog dry_run仍dispatch，读写action都非纯被动；不采纳bridge。
live.handoff.service.items.reviewed_semantics: item_abilities/item/item_field read and write actions; item_catalog is create/remove/create-list and its dry_run still dispatches bridge here.

live.handoff.service.loadout_runtime.name: Operation-local inventory reads and definition checks for loadout restoration.
live.handoff.service.loadout_runtime.prior_decision: restore_scope finally可刷新装备效果，非纯context manager；不导入。
live.handoff.service.loadout_runtime.reviewed_semantics: Operation-local inventory always queries extension; restore_scope finally may refresh equipment effects, including during exceptional exit.

live.handoff.service.map_catalog.name: Offline campaign/map object catalogue. Opens source archives read-only.
live.handoff.service.map_catalog.prior_decision: 离线只读源archive/临时campaign child与来源复核可用；产品已有pack/catalog；离线语义归offline总审。
live.handoff.service.map_catalog.reviewed_semantics: Source archives opened read-only; campaign children written only to TemporaryDirectory. Source hash/stat rechecked; exports create new files. Baseline/reference merging is not game runtime truth.

live.handoff.service.mouse_terrain.name:
Bounded intersection of a camera ray and the game's terrain height field.

The target plane only defines the ray. A landing point must independently
satisfy the terrain equation; a small change between iterates is insufficient.
No process addresses, game versions or execution routes belong here.
live.handoff.service.mouse_terrain.prior_decision: 纯射线求交需passive height provider；产品无已校准运行terrain来源，未知明确保留。
live.handoff.service.mouse_terrain.reviewed_semantics: Numerical ray/terrain algorithm; height_at callback may have effects supplied by caller. Reuse only with a passive height provider; does not itself open process or issue game commands.

live.handoff.service.operation_trace.name: Request-scoped diagnostics; observing a report never replays an operation.
live.handoff.service.operation_trace.prior_decision: 日志自身无游戏调用，可参考request级失败完整性；产品已有live journal/report，未引入native request日志格式。
live.handoff.service.operation_trace.reviewed_semantics: Request-scoped local logs, hashes, structured reports; preserves original exception and does not replay. No game calls performed by trace itself.

live.handoff.service.save_extraction.name: Offline save-code files and session-bound, read-only game string extraction.
live.handoff.service.save_extraction.prior_decision: 文件/被动live字符串来源可借鉴，产品savecodes已有；native总审确认无bridge；完整功能采纳由offline/frontend闭环。
live.handoff.service.save_extraction.reviewed_semantics: File scanning/exports separated from read_live_codes using ExternalMemoryBackend session-bound reads. Export new files atomically; no game bridge in live-code method itself.

live.handoff.service.speed.name: Process-wide speed service; retained hooks belong to GameSession resources.
live.handoff.service.speed.prior_decision: 持久speed hook/DLL与恢复操作是进程写入，不采纳。
live.handoff.service.speed.reviewed_semantics: requires write, attaches SpeedClockBackend DLL and sets/restores process-wide rate; excluded from read-only product.

live.handoff.service.talent_definitions.name: Discover map-defined native ATal controllers using exact unit identities.
live.handoff.service.talent_definitions.prior_decision: bound_target先native绑定才读adapter definitions；不是整体被动。
live.handoff.service.talent_definitions.reviewed_semantics: bound_target uses native bind_unit_refs before external memory adapter definitions/records reads; catalog merge alone is local.

live.handoff.service.talent_points.name: Grant one canonical controller point without creating a map-defined item.
live.handoff.service.talent_points.prior_decision: write=True直接增点并复核，游戏写入不采纳。
live.handoff.service.talent_points.reviewed_semantics: grant_controller_point opens memory_factory(write=True), invokes ExternalMemoryBackend.increment_talent_point then verifies bound identity.

live.handoff.service.unit_type.name: Classic-style runtime type-ID editing; the separate skin ID stays untouched.
live.handoff.service.unit_type.prior_decision: 运行时type-ID修改及条件rollback不采纳，产品只读rawcode。
live.handoff.service.unit_type.reviewed_semantics: Runtime type-ID setter writes one u32 and conditionally rolls back only known old/target values; preserves skin ID and reports morph_effect_verified=False.

live.handoff.service.units.name: units operations; transport and lifecycle belong to GameSession.
live.handoff.service.units.prior_decision: hero/stat/binding读取和clone/position/spawn写入均经过operation桥，交native矩阵，不引入。
live.handoff.service.units.reviewed_semantics: Hero/stat/binding read actions and clone/action/position/spawn writes dispatch engine._execute. Typed identity checking and required resolver fields precede calls.

live.handoff.service.world.name: world operations; transport and lifecycle belong to GameSession.
live.handoff.service.world.prior_decision: camera/terrain/map_bounds query经过bridge，world/bulk还写入；不作为产品已支持现场能力。
live.handoff.service.world.reviewed_semantics: game_speed read/write; world/bulk writes; mouse/screen/camera/terrain/map_bounds query through bridge.

live.tls.passive-context.name: 被动获取窗口线程TLS与本地模式
live.tls.passive-context.prior_decision: 不把3.0 x64 TLS链硬套classic；产品已有独立本地玩家/选择读取路径。x64兼容仍需目标布局与frame证据。
live.tls.passive-context.reviewed_semantics: 读窗口所属TID/PID与NtQueryInformationThread的TEB；从本机OS TlsGetValue机器码识别primary/expansion布局；按profile读取game TLS/context/bridge/mode并逐链复核。代码验证只重试partial-copy299；帧对象退场299/487可重试完整采样。无进入游戏线程。

live.compat.session-wrapper.name: 兼容API的会话绑定与缓存失效
live.compat.session-wrapper.prior_decision: 不复制名称驱动准入或大量兼容状态缓存。产品保持每次live调用新探针/结构化结果；所有native服务传递副作用由native矩阵承接。
live.compat.session-wrapper.reviewed_semantics: 包装public方法，建立prepare/profile/session scope，跨PID新建会话保留旧资源；同PID窗口变更失效；ContextVar避免递归重复prepare；列出NATIVE_ONLY/READ_ONLY/QUERY_OPERATIONS与cache default。查询资格委托OperationSpec，非native方法还需basic_fields。

live.components.delegate.name: 组件读取薄委派

functions.name: _delete_extension_bag_item_24268
functions.reachability: normal_helper

functions.name: equip_extension_bag_slot_24268

functions.name: _extension_inventory_equipment_records_24268
functions.reachability: managed_passive_legacy_conditional
functions.behavior: Normal managed route enumerates externally read component nodes then adapter.inventory_records reads AIni/AEqu ownership/count/capacity/pointers. Legacy ability enumeration may invoke helper depending on host state, so body is not a universal passive API (462-474; facade_fields:254-302; war3_adapter_modules:29-48).

functions.name: _equip_non_equipment_item_to_slot_24268
functions.reachability: normal_any_slot
functions.behavior: Requires one selected hero then equipment_effects.perform equip=True; classification creates/removes temporary object and callback performs native equip/classification changes (477-483; equipment_effects:241-308).

functions.name: equip_extension_bag_item_to_slot_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Context-local equipment_slot_transaction guards slot recursion/collision only; delegates complete mutation to private implementation. Context guard does not make game writes atomic (486-489).

functions.name: _equip_extension_bag_item_to_slot_24268
functions.reachability: normal_direct_record_write_test_branch_separate

Active route uses native unequip/equip, ProcessMemory(write=True), profile adapter.move_record, displaced-instance recursion and stat refresh. Partial raw-record move permits restoring native post-equip records only; timeout/uncertain cleanup retains state and stops recovery (492-706; war3_backend:3155; war3_adapter_modules:62-73).

functions.name: _unequip_non_equipment_slot_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: classify_state can run temporary-item preflight. Recognized flags/class/cache state then performs equipment_effect unequip action=2; otherwise refuses to move records and reports diagnostic (709-717).

functions.name: unequip_extension_slot_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Fresh extension snapshot; managed nonempty slot uses temporary-item preflight to choose ordinary-item removal path. Formal equipment requires spare bag capacity then extension action=2; no identity-free slot removal fallback (720-743).

functions.name: save_extension_loadout_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Reads extension through bridge then stores handle/rawcode/type/charges and any-slot requirement in local per-PID/target dictionaries, also legacy local compatibility record. It does not write a file or change inventory in this body (746-787).

functions.name: extension_loadout_names_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Returns plan_choices of local saved records filtered by PID; duplicate display names receive code/index and collisions raise. Public session wrapper may first prepare process, but method body does no game access (790-792; war3_loadout_restore:3-15; war3_trainer_session:84-121).

functions.name: save_extension_loadouts_for_selected_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Delegates run_loadout_batch save: native extension selection snapshots and per-target local save; skips nonheroes/no 30-slot bag and returns per-target successes/skips/failures. No mutation command on save branch beyond bridge selection temporary groups (795-797; war3_loadout_restore:18-59).

functions.name: restore_extension_loadouts_for_selected_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Delegates run_loadout_batch restore; binds current targets, selects unique per-type plan and calls restore_extension_loadout. It regenerates/moves equipment, not merely loads a local record (800-802; war3_loadout_restore:60-76).

functions.name: _restore_extension_loadout_handles_24268
functions.reachability: normal_helper
functions.behavior: Requires current exact target, unique item identities and matching rawcodes; reorders nine slots in fixed weapon-first order with fresh snapshots. Uses native unequip and exact equip/redirection, verifies final tuple. No blanket old-memory replay (805-880).

functions.name: locations
functions.reachability: normal_helper
functions.behavior: Nested in _restore_extension_loadout_handles_24268; maps all supplied bag/equipment nonzero handles to area/slot/rawcode and rejects duplicate handle appearances. No I/O (814-823).

functions.name: restore_extension_loadout_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Selects unique named/imported/legacy local plan; multiple current selections invoke batch apply. Otherwise regenerate_loadout creates missing instances, preserves reusable matching slot/charge pairs and restores target layout. Serialized old handles are not treated as live identities for regeneration (883-913; war3_loadout_restore:91-215).

functions.name: audit_extension_equipment_24268
functions.reachability: normal_repair_flag
functions.behavior: Always reads bridge snapshot. repair=False computes duplicate-instance/type-slot issues locally after the read. repair=True checks spare bag space, unequips all bad slots and recursively audits again; not a read-only audit API (916-957).

functions.name: set_extension_equipment_any_slot_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Reads bridge snapshot, validates AIni/AEqu external records when enabling, changes only local per-PID/target boolean, and reads another bridge snapshot. Does not invoke obsolete extension action=9 nor itself move an equipment record; later equip observes this switch (960-980).

functions.name: selected_talent_batch_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Initial/current bridge snapshots, controller uniqueness and choice matching then grant/reset/add-choice per target. Exceptions are recorded per-target and iteration continues; successes/skips/failures and last snapshot remain distinct. No all-or-nothing guarantee (983-1022).

functions.name: grant_talent_point_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Reads exact current talent state and capacity; helper binds native/full identities then external adapter writes point counter once. Repeated reads for up to one second verify +1; command is not replayed on missing readback (1025-1047; talent_points:17-42; war3_adapter_modules:621-658).

functions.name: talent_state_24268
functions.reachability: normal_and_snapshot_fixture
functions.behavior: No snapshot/empty dict starts bridge snapshot. Snapshot plus PID official controller reads external records and production external selection; custom records route performs bridge bind_unit_refs. No-PID supplied snapshot uses derived level fallback only. Live read failure raises instead of applying fallback (1050-1156; talent_definitions:54-63).

functions.name: unlock_talent_tier_24268
functions.reachability: managed_blocked_after_reads
functions.behavior: Validates snapshot/controller/selected tier and calls identity-bound old helper. Normal constructed GameSession causes _run_native_helper_ops immediate rejection even for talent-unlock-only; no normal managed unlock occurs. Sessionless legacy may proceed to injected helper. No current caller found in Python/TS/Svelte except definition (1159-1199; war3_backend:3174,4780-4802).

functions.name: _talent_icon_candidate_24268
functions.reachability: helper
functions.behavior: Uses override or selected candidates; if no exact handle match with indexed backend, performs ability_batch AIxr query and unique-rawcode cross-check. Rejects ambiguity; cannot call this universally passive due native fallback (1202-1218).

functions.name: add_talent_choice_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Validates chosen tree/tier/choice, no-op if already selected. Otherwise adds ability, removes newly added ability, re-adds it to refresh game card; failure attempts removal. No native point debit or UI-hook installation here, despite older docstring (1221-1266).

functions.name: _talent_icon_display_path_24268
functions.reachability: helper
functions.behavior: Resolves four local candidate DLL paths and selects first existing file; no DLL is loaded by this helper. Existence does not validate ABI/hash or compatible game build (1269-1280).

functions.name: refresh_talent_icon_display_24268
functions.reachability: normal_application_entry
functions.behavior: Existing component snapshot can be pure owned-state read but failure triggers close/restore. Otherwise constructs TalentIconDisplay and install maps/patches code via bridge; uncertain close retains owner and explicit diagnostic. Caller exists at war3_application:1829-1838. Prefix refresh is not passivity (1283-1327).

functions.name: select_native_talent_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Validates controller/tier/choice/no native record/positive points, derives profile-specific order, issues one talent_order, then reads until actual native choice and decremented points match. Timeout says command was not resent (1330-1351).

functions.name: reset_talents_24268
functions.reachability: normal
functions.behavior: Requires true live point source and identified native records, then removes/recreates controller and choices, grants points, and verifies storage unchanged. Failure attempts rebuild/refund/reselect native choices/add extra effects and reports rollback errors. Compensation is active mutation and not proven atomic rollback (1354-1445).

functions.name: clear_and_rebuild
functions.reachability: normal_and_compensation
functions.behavior: Nested reset helper re-reads state, removes every present choice and controller, adds fresh controller then checks zero points/records. Used both initial reset and compensating recovery (1376-1391).

functions.name: grant_until
functions.reachability: normal_and_compensation
functions.behavior: Nested reset helper checks remaining point count, invokes grant_talent_point once per deficit and verifies final count. Cannot exceed requested target silently; still direct memory writes with binding and snapshots (1393-1406).

functions.name: _restore_extra_talent_choices_24268
functions.reachability: normal_compensation_helper
functions.behavior: For every selected choice differing from native_choice, calls add_talent_choice_24268 to recreate extra effect. No point refund is inferred from these free extra effects (1448-1455).
