reachability_corrections: No unconditional post-return legacy tail was found in this facade. Specific compatibility branches remain conditional.
Normal constructed hosts have GameSession and _elephant_selection_override, so the special no-attribute extension action=12 branch is not the production exact-slot route.
unlock_talent_tier reaches legacy helper call only after bridge reads, but normal GameSession makes helper reject before installing/running it.
add_talent_choice uses ability add/remove/add and does not call optional talent icon installation; explicit application refresh entry still exists.
Public READ_ONLY membership and refresh/inspect naming are policy labels, not passive side-effect proofs.

native.source.war3_services.facade_field.name: war3_services/facade_fields.py
native.source.war3_services.facade_field.prior_decision: Passive source/identity/protocol evidence only. Actual operation behavior, game-thread effects, version assumptions, cleanup and replay boundaries are retained in linked authored reports; no target DLL/native execution or live write imported into product. Existing/adopted passive product evidence is identified in those reports.

reviewed_semantics.method: Every source line 1-2866 read as text in six contiguous spans; manual semantic branch review, with AST only verifying function inventory/ranges. Supporting files read only at stated ranges.

files.adoption_decision: No facade/runtime implementation copied. Independently reimplement passive identity/freshness, explicit partial diagnostics and field-value provenance only; exclude every bridge, setter, process-memory write, synthetic input and trainer-only limit/ASCII heuristic.

functions.name: _selected_components
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Managed indexed branch rereads the live owner-component list on every call (9-13). Non-indexed branch validates cached identity, then direct/wrapper/index evidence; caches and misses are host state. No setter in this body. Reimplement freshness/identity only; legacy scan and omission semantics are not complete-product proof.

functions.name: _validated_owner_components
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Delegates to current_profile().adapter.legacy validation over supplied memory. No game callback/setter here. Depends on the selected adapter/layout, not on the compatibility method name.

functions.name: _scan_component_index
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Delegates legacy component-index scan over supplied memory. No native execution requested here. Keep provider/version and incomplete-scan diagnostics; do not adopt trainer scan bounds as completeness.

functions.name: _scan_component_index_win10
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Delegates the Win10 legacy component-index scan. The Windows label does not select a different current-session engine or prove a compatible build.

functions.name: _rebuild_component_index
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Reads through _scan_component_index and replaces local component cache/miss set. Cache absence is not independently proved absence of a game component.

functions.name: _component_map_for_owners
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Optionally rebuilds cache, validates each requested owner and returns only nonempty components. No target write; validation errors/empty entries must not become absence claims when re-expressed in product.

functions.name: _append_unit_field
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Reads one supplied address via _read_memory_value, silently omits OSError/nonfinite float, then builds UnitMemoryField. write_address/extra_writes only describe later capability; this function does not perform them. Product should retain read-failure diagnostics.

functions.name: _append_attack_fields
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Delegates attack.append_fields with profile, supplied memory and current-build/timing context. Field capability metadata is not execution; layout correctness remains adapter evidence.

functions.name: _attack_timing_24268_from_memory
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Delegates current-profile attack.timing(pm,data). Passive memory computation in the adapter path; the numeric filename label is not a compatibility check.

functions.name: _looks_like_rawcode
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Masks to uint32, requires four printable ASCII bytes and at least one uppercase letter. No I/O. Reject as a GameXRay identity validator: legitimate four-byte Latin-1/numeric/punctuation/space identities differ.

functions.name: _looks_like_item_rawcode
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Masks to uint32 and accepts only ASCII alphanumerics. No I/O. Do not transfer to GameXRay's complete four-byte Latin-1 identity boundary.

functions.name: _ability_instance_from_wrapper
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Delegates profile.abilities.instance with candidate/wrapper and component exclusions; no mutation here. Preserve full handle/data/wrapper identity rather than copying fixed layout offsets.

functions.name: _validated_cached_ability_instances
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Rereads owner, data, unit-owner, rawcode, mirror and current-instance state for every cached ability, rejecting stale cache. This validates existing rows, not the absence of newly added rows. Managed branch bypasses this legacy cache in _ability_instances_from_candidate.

functions.name: _near_ability_instances_from_candidate
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Delegates near-candidate legacy ability inspection. No native operation in wrapper. Proximity and adapter-specific limits are evidence candidates, not definitive product identities.

functions.name: _ability_instances_from_candidate
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Managed branch uses ObjectRegistry24268/read_unit_component_nodes and verifies (handle,data) before returning (265-284). Legacy native-snapshot branch invokes identity and bound-ability helper ops (285-339), blocked by managed backend gate. Legacy allow_global_scan raises at 345-346; no global scan is actually performed there. Profile tag, 4096 helper result bound and ASCII gates do not transfer.

functions.name: _inventory_record_address
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Calls profile.items.inventory_record with AInv and indexed flag. Resolves a record only; no object creation or setter in this body.

functions.name: _item_object_from_handle
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Calls profile.items.item_data_near_owner using pointer/rawcode/vtable heuristics. Read-only wrapper, version-qualified; do not treat heuristic success as portable item identity.

functions.name: _item_objects_from_handles
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Delegates legacy item-object resolution for supplied handles/owner. Retain complete identity and failure evidence in any independent passive implementation.

functions.name: _native_snapshot_for_candidate
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Pure host-cache/bound-snapshot lookup: full handle+owner+unit must agree, and a candidate explicitly marked persistent_native cannot borrow another cached payload. No fresh process read; snapshot is not current runtime evidence by itself.

functions.name: _native_inventory_items
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Bound-unit identity plus inventory helper ops; requires two results and six-slot completion then parses 49 words. _run_native_helper_ops rejects every managed GameSession at backend:4798. Not a normal managed injected path, and not adoptable as a passive reader.

functions.name: _parse_native_inventory_items
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Pure parse of 49 supplied words/six slots with empty-slot and duplicate full/native/object identity checks. Profile supplies reported addresses; invalid mirror/ability ASCII spellings become zero. Schemas/identity distinction are useful; six slots and lossy rawcode filtering are not product-wide inventory limits.

functions.name: _inventory_items_from_candidate
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Managed external path resolves profile inventory slot count/stride and reads handles/item fields. Bound native snapshot instead delegates _native_inventory_items (legacy gate applies). External OSError can become empty/zero metadata; reimplementation must preserve unknown/failure rather than report emptiness.

functions.name: _native_unit_field_memory
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Invokes identity+bound-unit-field helper, validates fixed 346-word payload, parses its 49-word inventory part and component generation pairs. Blocked in normal managed backend; fake memory view is data already returned by active helper, not independent passive access.

functions.name: _unit_fields_from_candidate
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Builds basic/property/hero/attack/inventory evidence from memory or bound legacy snapshots. Managed indexed path attempts unit_stats at 625-630 and live pid+hwnd path stat_details at 668-680; those use Engine24268 dispatch. A bridge failure preserves confirmed external fields and appends diagnostics, not all-or-nothing empty output. Field writability is metadata until a writer runs. Do not import whole function into passive product.

functions.name: note_optional_query_failure
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Nested field-reader helper writes an operation-failure log, appends warning and a diagnostic field; log failure is caught and retained in note. No game operation in this body. Useful explicit partial-result reporting model.

functions.name: append_native_real
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Nested builder accepts finite supplied float, creates a field and marks basic native-setter capability. Does not query or mutate game state itself; supplied snapshot provenance remains required.

functions.name: append_native_int
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Nested integer field builder records a supplied value/address/write capability. No memory access or game mutation in its body.

functions.name: read_selected_unit_fields
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Gets selected-candidate snapshot, chooses first selected unit for this single-unit panel, builds summaries and fields, and caches summaries. Managed selection is external at backend:5444-5450; field construction may invoke the new bridge. A read_ prefix is not a passive-access guarantee.

functions.name: _recover_win10_native_handlers
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Copies/discovers handler records, validates readable record region, executable entry and name length, merges host handler cache and logs recovered/missing counts. It does not invoke handlers. No direct name-call site found in the checkout beyond this definition; do not present as active normal bootstrap.

functions.name: _win10_memory_operation
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Creates host logger and Win10ProcessMemory(write=caller flag), yields it, logs outcome and closes logger. Default is read access; opening write-capable handle is capability, caller body determines actual memory side effects. No direct checkout call site found; not an alternate production field route.

functions.name: _win10_session_for_identity
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Discards identity/memory arguments and returns self. Does not create an isolated scanner or a second execution engine; comment and executed return agree.

functions.name: trainer_for_read_source
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Returns self regardless of identity/display-source flag. Source labels do not select different engines or provide identity validation.

functions.name: _seed_win10_isolated_state
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Merges owner/resource/component/native-handler caches into supplied isolated host; resets selected-handle locations to constants. No target read/write inside function. Existing cache membership is not freshness proof; no direct checkout call site found.

functions.name: _win10_candidate_from_identity
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Calls supplied host's _candidate_from_identity and raises on None. No alternate reader creation or own write; supplied provider determines current identity evidence.

functions.name: read_selected_unit_fields_win10
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Unconditional return self.read_selected_unit_fields(). No isolated Win10 heap-scan implementation remains in this method; inherits normal managed mixed read/bridge path.

functions.name: read_unit_fields_by_identity
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Resolves requested full handle+owner+unit, raises stale candidate, then builds panel and fields using bound snapshot or external memory. Managed identity provider uses registry resolution; field query still may use Engine24268.

functions.name: read_unit_fields_by_identity_win10
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Unconditional delegation to normal by-identity reader. The compatibility suffix is not a separate passive source.

functions.name: _skill_index_from_field_key
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Parses skillN_name and bounds N by host HERO_SKILL_SLOT_COUNT. Pure local selector; fixed UI slots must not become full ability-enumeration limits.

functions.name: _map_hero_skill_instances
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Sorts supplied instances, excludes B-prefixed candidates, matches exact rawcodes first, then fills missing identities from anchored positional windows or equal-count zip. No I/O, but fallback can associate differing rawcodes; must not be adopted as confirmed identity evidence.

functions.name: _hero_skill_instance_map
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Reads profile hero config slots then calls _ability_instances_from_candidate(allow_global_scan=True) and heuristic map. Indexed branch reads components; legacy unbound branch raises instead of global scan. No direct checkout caller found; name alone does not establish active feature.

functions.name: _hero_skill_instance_map_for_write
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Finds unique rawcode/data identities from native ability list or engine resolver, then restricted fallback enumeration. Does not itself write. Normal managed _write_hero_skill_name_field returns to current-build writer before reaching its legacy caller at 1878; helper's old native operations are gated.

functions.name: _ability_runtime_template_from_instance
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Reads eight bytes at each configured runtime-template offset into a host dictionary. No writes; caller and profile establish addresses. Used by abilities compatibility code, not proof the template can be transferred across instances/builds.

functions.name: _write_ability_runtime_template
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Validates each eight-byte template field immediately before writing it, then writes rawcode, mirror and wrapper tag. Earlier fields may be changed before a later validation failure. No direct checkout caller found beyond definition; do not advertise it as current public implementation, and do not adopt.

functions.name: _ability_template_source_is_live
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Resolves candidate owner/unit and requires finite/ranged positive current/max HP. Read-only, but positive HP is this helper's suitability heuristic, not a general proof of object existence or complete live inventory.

functions.name: _ability_template_source_candidate
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Same owner/unit and positive HP checks, returning candidate instead of bool. Preserve as suitability evidence only, never infer missing/dead object absence in product.

functions.name: _find_ability_runtime_template
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Delegates legacy template discovery with excluded wrapper/data sets. No write in this wrapper; no portable cross-build template behavior is established.

functions.name: _selected_ability_level_for_candidate
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Resolves selected native handle/handler and invokes GetUnitAbilityLevel through old helper. Managed helper gate rejects it; current skill-replacement branch returns before this legacy caller. Getter spelling does not make its hypothetical old route passive.

functions.name: _write_hero_skill_name_field_24268
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Checks one selected hero/config/duplicates; bridge-queries old/new ability levels, removes old and adds new, then writes hero config+cache directly. Exception path conditionally removes/restores abilities and guarded config values. changed_runtime becomes true only after new-add validation, so no general atomic rollback guarantee. Entire runtime operation excluded.

functions.name: _write_hero_skill_name_field
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Indexed case returns immediately to current-build writer (1834-1837). Bound old snapshot uses legacy replace helper; remaining legacy path resolves/remakes ability, directly writes config/cache/tag/rawcodes and posts hero refresh input. Second indexed check at 1858 is redundant under stable host state; 1864+ is a legacy tail, not globally dead code.

functions.name: _inventory_slot_index_from_field_key
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Parses inventory_slot_N excluding charge suffix; accepts ordinary slots 1..6. Pure UI selector, not all equipment/backpack inventory coverage.

functions.name: _inventory_slot_charges_index_from_field_key
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Parses inventory_slot_N_charges for ordinary slots 1..6 only. Pure local selection; do not project six slots onto all game storage.

functions.name: _inventory_slot_snapshot
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Finds requested slot in _inventory_items_from_candidate. Inherits external or gated old-native query source; no own write. No direct checkout caller found.

functions.name: _write_inventory_slot_field
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Managed path queries item selection and engine.equipment(action=0), whose C handler creates/reads/removes a temporary item. Equipment goes to action=1 equip; ordinary item goes to exact-slot action=7 replacement with expected item. Old path revalidates snapshot and calls legacy inventory replacement; readbacks are not global rollback. All runtime branches excluded.

functions.name: _write_inventory_slot_charges_field
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Bound old snapshot uses identity-bound helper; ordinary managed/indexed branch writes charges via pm.write_i32 and reads back (2318-2321). Non-indexed old path catches helper RuntimeError/TimeoutError then writes directly (2323-2330). Hero refresh posts F1 messages. Quantity clamps/999 bound and fallback semantics are trainer-specific and excluded.

functions.name: _component_field_write_op
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Validates bound component/type and numeric value, emits old-helper operation tuple. No dispatch or memory write here; represents a write request. Keep typed validation concept only, not payload/offset/limits.

functions.name: _write_true_attack_speed_field
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Validates finite target APS/component/field address then calls attack_speed_24268 with positive target, returning actual speed and cooldown readback. New Engine service dispatches attack_speed. Excluded from passive product.

functions.name: _write_native_component_fields
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Groups/chunks bound component setter ops, prepends unit identity and requires exact result kind/bits. Old helper rejects managed GameSession; mixed batches are not atomic and earlier completed writes remain possible in an enabled legacy host.

functions.name: _write_unit_fields_to_candidate
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Special-cases type mutation alone; opens managed write memory; rebuilds fields (may issue bridge queries), resolves capabilities/duplicates, batches basic/component writes, then executes stat/attack/intelligence/skill/item/generic memory setters. It prevalidates selected classes but later setter-specific coercion can follow earlier writes; no transaction-wide rollback. Exclude complete operation.

functions.name: write_selected_unit_fields
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Empty requests return; otherwise resolves current selected candidate and calls mixed writer. Public managed wrapper requires write-capable session. No read-only adoption.

functions.name: write_selected_unit_field
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Constructs one MemoryWriteSpec and delegates to multi-field writer, returning first written field. Does not change the underlying side-effect classification.

functions.name: write_unit_field_by_identity
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Resolves explicit identity (inventory keys waive registry_required in this call), opens write memory for indexed backend and dispatches field write. Candidate validation and setter checks still apply; waiver is not generic arbitrary-address access authorization.

functions.name: write_unit_field_by_identity_win10
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Unconditionally delegates to normal by-identity writer; not a separate backup implementation.

functions.name: locate_current_selected_unit
functions.behavior_and_reachability: Resolves current selected candidate and returns its panel. Normal managed selection/panel are external-memory observations; no field-detail bridge is called by this function itself.

v2122.frontend.decision: Full prior 16-page/78-RPC workflow review linked by current source hashes. GameXRay uses CustomTkinter with current cancellation/ticket conventions. Source archive/live-code dict/list shape mismatches and Elephant action routing remain source defects; no second Trainer interface is needed to reuse the patterns.

v2122.catalog.name: Complete map/campaign object catalog, fields, selection/export
v2122.catalog.decision: Existing product records retain category/source/child scope, full fields, Boolean matching and complete multi-record exports. Trainer's 200-result/ASCII and field-float shortcuts are not source-of-truth improvements.

v2122.metadata.name: Versioned four-category editor metadata
v2122.metadata.decision: Prior 0.11 evidence adopts explicit upgrade category, all 1294 category declarations/1284 identities, build/source provenance and retained translation differences. The supplied Trainer metadata generator has a missing local helper; use the independent product generator and exact source data instead of importing Trainer code.

v2122.upgrade-catalog.name: Ninety build-qualified bilingual stock upgrades
v2122.upgrade-catalog.decision: Prior exhaustive comparison found all 90 IDs already present. Snapshot translations/descriptions can be compared with explicit build/source qualification, but cannot replace map-local fields or claim current runtime availability. Full generated data is retained by the prior Python report.

v2122.mpq-recovery.name: Exact MPQ hash-entry/locale/block and reference closure
v2122.mpq-recovery.decision: Product independently adopts exact member reads, collision-safe output, named encrypted-member scans, listfile propagation and model/portrait references to closure. Current source comments/caps are not a reason to reduce GameXRay coverage.

v2122.archive-copy-write.name: V1 hash-table preservation and staged map/campaign writes
v2122.archive-copy-write.decision: This is real staged-copy authoring, including capacity changes/header repairs/definition modifications and verification. Source-file read-only alone does not logically prohibit a new-copy workflow, but the current product acceptance and source-reuse task do not establish safe/game-compatible authoring. This inventory adds no writer or native DLL dependency.

v2122.huolong.name: HKE payload catalogs, menus, options and generation
v2122.huolong.decision: Actual generating route, all original payloads and changed control flow are hash-linked to the Huolong review. Documentation and saved options are not evidence that generation consumes them. HKE generated actions mutate game state; independent static script diagnostics remain the applicable product use.

v2122.job-lifecycle.name: Asynchronous map jobs, cancellation and immutable result snapshots
v2122.job-lifecycle.decision: Prior frontend analysis proves the start-request/job-ID cancellation race. Use current product worker tickets/cancellation and validate real terminal state; source 'stopped' presentation does not prove pending work stopped. No new job workflow is necessary without a concrete product operation.

v2122.script-boundaries.name: Byte-preserving JASS lexical/function/globals boundaries
v2122.script-boundaries.decision: Source boundary parser/injector is statically reviewed. Product already owns language-sensitive lexical views, offsets, scopes and diagnostics. Trainer's 32 MiB/token limits and ASCII symbol-only assumptions are not transplanted; the script insertion half belongs to authoring.

v2122.compiler.name: Pinned pjass subprocess and syntax/type claim
v2122.compiler.decision: Exact binary and code section match prior disassembly/control-flow evidence. Source compiler annotations can suppress reported errors while process returncode remains zero; Trainer then sets syntax_and_types=True. GameXRay 0.11 does not ship/run this sampled binary and its static diagnostics do not certify full compilation. A separately sourced strict compiler would need its own design and acceptance.

v2122.compiler-libraries.name: Classic/modern JASS interface library pack
v2122.compiler-libraries.decision: All five members and all four library hashes verified, full text and declaration census saved. Build-qualified declarations are usable comparison evidence; they do not establish availability in a different game or every library function's behavior.
